A 20-second HORIZONTAL live-action fantasy fight shot like real handheld footage in a misty pine forest at dusk. Two trolls ambush a horned young man and his small three-eyed Dalmatian puppy; when the man is thrown into a tree, the puppy bursts into BLUE flame and transforms into a giant three-eyed Dalmatian beast that throws both trolls away. It ends with the man placing his palm on the beast's head and the beast shrinking back into the puppy under his hand in a fading blue flame.

REFERENCES
image1 is the young man: copy his face, skin tone, curly platinum hair, pointed ears, horns (left black, right ivory), robe, belt with pouch, forearm straps and boots exactly.
image2 shows the dog in its TWO forms side by side: the SMALL sitting Dalmatian on the left is the puppy (before), the GIANT snarling Dalmatian on the right is the beast (after). Copy the fur, spot pattern, three eyes (two brown, centre blue), body shape, fangs and claws exactly. These are the SAME dog: never show both forms in the same frame.
Use the references only for characters. Ignore their grey studio background, the setting is the forest described below.

MAIN SUBJECT
Young man from image1, about 20, slim athletic build, deep brown skin, short tightly curled platinum-blonde hair, pale grey eyes, long pointed elf-like ears. TWO curved ram-like horns growing from his head: the LEFT horn is matte BLACK, the RIGHT horn is IVORY WHITE. He wears a long off-white hooded robe with frayed raw edges, dense opaque woven fabric with a subtle raised glyph-like texture, hood down, a layered short cape over the shoulders, a diagonal closure with small brown leather toggles across the chest. Wide brown leather sash belt tied at the waist with a small brown leather pouch on his left hip. Brown leather straps wrapped in a criss-cross around both forearms. Worn dark-brown leather mid-calf boots. The robe stays fully opaque and in place throughout.

COMPANION
Small Dalmatian puppy from image2 (left), knee-high to the man: white short fur with black round spots, floppy black-spotted ears, two brown eyes and a THIRD eye in the centre of the forehead with a pale BLUE iris, always open. Thin white tail.
Transformed beast from image2 (right): the SAME Dalmatian, about 3.5 metres tall at the shoulder, heavily muscled, same white fur and black spots stretched over the larger body, same three open eyes (two brown, centre one blue), wide jaw with long ivory fangs, huge paws with thick curved black claws, same thin long tail. Its spot pattern and eye colours never change.

BLUE FLAME
Pale electric-blue flame with soft white highlights. It rises from the dog's back and shoulders in a tall flickering column straight upward, wraps thinly around the head and ears, and licks low along the ground around all four paws, reflecting on the damp dark soil. While the flame burns, the black spots glow translucent BLUE as if lit from inside, the white fur stays white, and the centre eye blazes with a bright white-blue starlike light with a small soft halo. When the flame dies, the spots are black again and the centre eye is a plain blue iris. The flame does NOT burn: fur, ferns, needles and the man's robe are not scorched, no smoke, no ash. It appears ONLY from 00:07 to 00:11 and during the shrinking (00:17-00:20).

TROLLS
TWO trolls, each about 2.5 metres tall, hunched and heavy, grey-green leathery skin with patches of moss, small deep-set yellow eyes, wide flat noses, thick bare arms, ragged brown hide loincloths, bare feet. Troll ONE carries a rough wooden log club about 1.5 metres long. Troll TWO is bare-handed.

LOCATION AND LAYOUT
Dense old pine forest at dusk after rain. A narrow path of damp dark soil with scattered pine needles and small puddles runs straight through a small clearing about 15 metres wide. Foreground: the path, moss-covered boulders, ferns. Middle ground: tall dark pine trunks 30 metres high around the clearing, low drifting fog between them, ONE thick pine trunk on the RIGHT edge of the path, and a few young birch trees about 15 cm thick on the LEFT edge of the clearing. Background: rows of trunks fading into grey mist. Troll ONE comes from the LEFT, Troll TWO from the RIGHT. All action stays in this clearing. Moving details: fog drifting, damp needles and soil kicked up by every step, branches swaying when hit, birds taking off from the treetops at the roar. No other people.

CAMERA AND LOOK
Realistic handheld cinematic footage, natural physical camera behaviour: light hand shake, slightly delayed autofocus on fast moves, mild bloom on the pale sky between trunks and on the blue flame, faint noise, muted contrast. ONE main light source for the whole video: soft overcast dusk light coming down through the canopy, cool blue-grey tone, soft shadows, natural skin tone, realistic fur and skin textures, practical-effects look. While the blue flame burns, it adds flickering blue light on the nearby trunks, fog, wet ground and faces, then this light disappears with the flame. Regular shots last 1.5-2.5 seconds; the EXCEPTIONS are the transformation (00:08-00:11), the leg throw (00:11-00:15) and the shrinking (00:17-00:20), each ONE continuous shot. Cuts only after a completed action, never in the middle of a throw. The camera and crew never appear in frame.

CONTINUOUS STORY

00:00-00:03 AMBUSH
Medium-wide, three-quarter front. Already in motion: the young man walks into the clearing along the path, the puppy trotting at his right boot. The puppy suddenly stops, plants its paws and growls. The man turns his head sharply. Out of the fog, Troll ONE steps in from the LEFT with the log club, Troll TWO from the RIGHT, heavy feet crushing ferns, wet soil splashing.

00:03-00:06 THE HIT
Wide shot, side angle, full bodies and ground visible. Troll TWO reaches him first, grabs him by the robe at both shoulders, lifts him off the ground and throws him to the RIGHT. Takeoff: his boots leave the ground. Flight: robe flaring, arms out. Landing: his back hits the thick pine trunk on the right edge of the path at waist height, he slides down onto the damp needles and ends on his side, left hand pressed to his ribs. The puppy runs to him.

00:06-00:08 TRIGGER
Close-up, low angle on the puppy's face beside the man's shoulder. The puppy looks at him, then slowly turns its head toward the trolls. All three eyes lock on them; the pupil of the blue centre eye narrows to a slit. At 00:07 the centre eye flares into a bright white-blue starlike light, a thin blue flame starts flickering around its paws, and the puppy walks three steps forward onto the path, placing itself between the man and the trolls. A thin growl deepens into a low rumble.

00:08-00:11 TRANSFORMATION
ONE continuous shot, low angle at ground level from the trolls' side, facing the dog: the blurred legs and bodies of the TWO trolls frame the left and right edges of the foreground, the dog in the centre faces them and the lens, and behind the dog the man is visible sitting against the pine. The puppy drops into a LOW crouch: front legs spread wide, chest close to the ground, head lowered, eyes staring straight ahead at the trolls and into the lens. The blue flame bursts up from its back in a tall column, the spots light up glowing blue, the flame licks around its spread paws and reflects on the wet soil. Holding this crouch, the dog grows inside the flame: legs thicken, shoulders and chest swell, paws widen, claws push out and crack the soil, and the camera pulls back and tilts up to keep the whole body in frame. It reaches 3.5 metres at the shoulder, taller than both trolls, matching the beast in image2. At the peak the flame drops off its body in one wave and dies on the ground, the spots turn back to black, the centre eye returns to a plain blue iris. The trolls step back. The beast rises from the crouch and roars, fangs visible; fog swirls from its breath and birds burst out of the treetops.

00:11-00:15 LEG THROW
ONE continuous shot, medium-wide, side angle, full bodies and ground visible. No flame. Troll ONE swings the log club at the beast's head; the beast drops low, the club passes over it, and the beast lunges and clamps its JAWS around Troll ONE's lower leg. It swings its head and body in a half circle, lifting the troll off the ground by the leg. Takeoff: the troll's body leaves the ground, the club falls from his hand. Flight: arms flailing, body rotating sideways toward the LEFT edge of the clearing. Contact: his back slams into a young birch trunk; the trunk SNAPS with a loud crack, bends and falls with him. The troll lands on the broken birch in the ferns.

00:15-00:17 SECOND TROLL
Wide shot. No flame. Troll TWO charges at the beast from the right with arms raised. The beast turns and bites his forearm, swings its head and flings him across the clearing. Flight, then landing: the troll hits the ground and rolls twice through the ferns toward the fog.

00:17-00:20 RETURN
ONE continuous shot, medium, three-quarter, low angle from beside the man. In the background fog both trolls scramble up and limp away into the trees. The man sits up against the pine trunk, left hand on his ribs, robe smeared with dirt. The beast lowers its giant head to him, breathing heavily, fog in its breath. He raises his RIGHT hand and places his palm flat on top of its head between the ears. A soft, low blue flame rises over the beast's body without burning his hand, the spots glow blue and the centre eye blazes white-blue, and the beast shrinks inside it in one smooth motion: body contracting, spots shrinking, claws retracting, its head sinking down while his palm stays on it and follows it down. The flame fades out as the small puppy from image2 sits under his hand, spots black again, centre eye plain blue. He gives a tired crooked smile and scratches it behind the ear. The puppy wags its tail. Final frame on the two of them in the misty clearing, no flame left.

SOUND
Only natural and in-world sound: wind in the pines, footsteps on wet soil, rustling ferns, heavy troll footsteps and grunts, the thud of the man hitting the pine and his pained exhale, the puppy's growl deepening into a rumble, a deep whoosh and roaring hum of the blue flame igniting, cracking soil and stretching sinew during the growth, the flame collapsing with a soft rush, a huge roar with birds' wings flapping away, the club whooshing over the beast, the troll's yell, the loud crack of the birch snapping, heavy bodies hitting the ground, crashing through ferns, distant limping footsteps, then quiet: the beast's heavy breathing, a soft low flame hum fading out, a puppy whimper, the man's breath. No music, no narration, no voiceover.

ESSENTIAL CONTINUITY
Events happen in this exact order: ambush, man thrown into the pine, trigger, transformation in blue flame, leg throw into the birch, second troll thrown, trolls flee in the background, beast shrinks back in a fading blue flame under the man's palm. During the transformation the dog faces the trolls, with the man behind it. The puppy and the beast are ONE dog from image2 and never appear together in one frame. The blue flame appears ONLY from 00:07 to 00:11 and during the shrinking; while it burns, the spots glow blue and the centre eye blazes white-blue, and when it dies the spots are black again and the centre eye is a plain blue iris. The flame never burns fur, plants, the robe or skin, and leaves no smoke or ash. Every throw has takeoff, flight and landing; no body passes through a tree, a troll or the ground. The beast grabs Troll ONE by the LEG with its JAWS, never with a paw. The birch breaks only when the troll hits it. The man's palm stays in contact with the beast's head during the whole shrinking. There are always exactly TWO trolls and ONE dog. The dog keeps the same spot pattern and three open eyes (two brown, centre blue) as puppy and as beast, exactly as in image2. The man keeps his look from image1 throughout: both horns (left black, right ivory), platinum curly hair, pointed ears, off-white frayed robe, brown sash belt with pouch, forearm straps and brown boots. One main light, same dusk clearing and fog throughout. Preserve his face, hair, horns, outfit, footwear throughout.

No slow motion, repeated actions, teleportation, duplicated characters, changing outfits, grey studio background, orange fire, smoke, burning plants, CGI appearance, captions, subtitles, watermarks, recording interface.

A first-person driving run through a high Alpine mountain pass on a cloudless midsummer late morning. The driver pilots a low two-door sports coupe with a pale silver-sage body along a narrow winding road carved into granite cliffs, overtakes slower traffic, plunges into a short dark rock tunnel, and bursts back out into a sunlit green valley. One unbroken 22-second POV take, 16:9.

LOCATION MAP
Foreground: the driver's two bare forearms and hands on a thick black suede-rimmed sports steering wheel, a brushed-steel link bracelet watch on the right wrist, black leather dashboard, a small glowing navigation screen right of the wheel, short gear lever at the lower right, the driver's dark-jeans knees at the bottom edge. The pale silver-sage door panel and wing mirror sit at the left frame edge.
Midground: two-lane grey asphalt with white edge lines, low dry-stone retaining walls, sheer pale grey-ochre granite cliffs rising close on both sides, a concrete avalanche gallery with arched openings, a round rock tunnel mouth.
Background: steep green alpine meadows, jagged blue-grey peaks with thin snow streaks, deep cobalt sky.
Sun high and slightly to camera right, hard and bright.

FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING
Frame one is already in motion at 70 km/h: both hands at ten and two on the wheel, a cliff wall filling the left window, a dark SUV 40 meters ahead in the lane, curve bending right. Windshield fills the top half, cabin the bottom half, wheel centered.

FORMAT MODE
One continuous shot, the camera does not cut on its own.

OPTICS
Ultra-wide 107° action-camera perspective with gentle barrel curvature at the edges, the near hands and wheel rim slightly enlarged, the A-pillars bowing inward. Fixed FOV, no drift for the full 22 seconds.

CAMERA
Head-mounted at the driver's eye height, 20 cm behind the wheel. The view sways with the driver's head: small 1 to 2 cm road-vibration tremor, leaning 5 degrees into each bend, a quick micro-glance left toward the wing mirror before overtaking. Wide tonal latitude, highlights rolling off softly in the sky, deep blacks inside the cabin, auto-exposure visibly adapting.

ACTION
0s to 3s: following the dark SUV through a right-hand curve, cliff rushing past the left window at 70 km/h. The driver checks the mirror, pulls left and overtakes cleanly, the SUV sliding past the right side of the windshield.
3s to 7s: road straightens, the coupe accelerates to 90 km/h, right hand slides up the rim as the driver feeds a long left sweeper beside a stone retaining wall.
7s to 10s: road dives into a narrow gorge, cliffs closing in on both sides, cabin dropping into cool shade, a concrete avalanche gallery passing on the right.
10s to 14s: gorge opens into a wide green valley, an oncoming car and a red motorcycle sweep past in the opposite lane, the driver hugs the right line through a tight left hairpin, hand-over-hand steering.
14s to 15.5s: a round black tunnel mouth bored into the rock grows ahead, the coupe enters it at 80 km/h.
15.5s to 17.5s: inside the tunnel the cabin goes nearly black, only the amber instrument glow and navigation screen lighting the hands, rough-hewn rock arch lit by a bright white exit circle growing ahead.
17.5s to 18.5s: exit in a burst of white overexposure that recovers within half a second to sunlit meadows.
18.5s to 22s: descending through a sunny S-bend above a green valley, two vehicles small in the distance, the driver relaxes both hands back to ten and two, the road unspooling toward the peaks. Hold on this view.

PERFORMANCE
Hands steady and precise, forearm tendons flexing on every steering input, fingers re-gripping the suede. Sun-warmed skin with fine arm hair and visible veins, the watch catching sharp glints.

PHYSICS
Body roll pushes the view 5 degrees outward in each curve, the wheel self-centers on exits, road texture transmits a fine buzz through the frame, passing cars produce a brief wind buffet, shadows from the cliffs slide across the dashboard in real time.

LIGHTING
Hard midday sun at 5600K, crisp shadows, strong windshield glare bands crossing the dash. Gorge shade cools the cabin to near 7000K. Tunnel interior lit only by the instrument cluster at 3200K amber and the white exit. Exposure rides the transitions naturally.

AUDIO
Diegetic only: flat-six engine note climbing and falling with throttle, downshift blips before the hairpin, tyre roar on asphalt, wind hiss at the door seals, the overtaken SUV whooshing past, the motorcycle's high whine passing, engine roar doubling in volume and echoing off the rock inside the tunnel, then opening up again outside.

STYLE
Photoreal action-camera driving footage, ultra-sharp 8K detail, saturated natural greens and cobalt sky, fine sensor noise in the tunnel, 60fps real-time motion.

OUTPUT SETTINGS
16:9, 22 seconds, real-time speed throughout.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Same two hands, same steel watch, same black suede wheel with a small plain round centre emblem in every second. Interior stays black leather, exterior paint stays pale silver-sage. Road surface, cliffs and peaks stay sharp and coherent. Driving stays on the right side of the road. The screen shows only an abstract map. A fitted dark charcoal athletic crop top with a muted red-and-blue graphic pattern, thin silver-grey straps and a deep scoop neckline showing prominent cleavage. Opaque, supportive fabric, a secure fit and the same neckline throughout. Her shoulders, arms and midriff are bare.

Tight black leather motorcycle trousers follow her narrow waist, rounded hips and full buttocks. Subtle protective panels, real seams and natural leather creases. Black motorcycle gloves and black riding boots.

Keep this exact outfit in every action shot. No jacket, racing suit, costume transformation or sudden addition of garments. Her face and ponytail remain visible.

MOTORCYCLE AND BRANDING

One full-size BMW sport motorcycle in navy-blue, silver and red livery. Keep the Red Bull emblem and "Red Bull" lettering on its fairings. Add a small BMW roundel on the upper side fairing: black ring, white "BMW", blue-and-white quartered centre. Both physical brands are visible in the opening.

Consistent fairing shape, windscreen, tank, exhaust, wheels and livery throughout. Correct motorcycle scale relative to MILA. Exactly two wheels, correctly connected forks and suspension.

The motorcycle has no wings or flying mechanisms. It follows a continuous airborne trajectory after leaving the ramp. MILA stays on the same motorcycle throughout the stunt.

During the stunt, hands stay on grips and legs on opposite sides of the bike. No fused hands or knees passing through the tank.

One closed Red Bull can is secured through the stunt in a locking holder beside the cockpit, visible in the opening. Only after stopping does she retrieve, open and drink from this SAME can.

LOCATION AND SPATIAL LOGIC

A high skyscraper rooftop above a dense modern city in ordinary late-morning daylight, with a blue sky and scattered white clouds.

The rooftop has a broad, firmly supported metal acceleration lane ending in a curved launch ramp. The approach is long enough to establish visible acceleration before takeoff. It has continuous support under both tires.

In the opening close shot, the launch lip is farther ahead, OUTSIDE the frame. Do not put her front wheel over the rooftop edge while she is stationary. A burnout spins the rear tire while the motorcycle remains in place; forward acceleration begins only when she launches.

The city skyline establishes the height, but keep the first shot tight on MILA and the motorcycle. Reveal the larger environment after the first cut.

Preserve the travel direction: the motorcycle moves toward screen right in exterior side views. The aircraft later travels in that same direction.

AIRCRAFT AND LANDING PLATFORM

A large, realistically built cargo aircraft in Red Bull livery flies below and ahead of the motorcycle's trajectory. It has a substantial flat stunt landing deck mounted lengthwise above its central fuselage, supported by visible structural brackets.

The deck is a deliberate physical structure wide enough for the motorcycle and long enough for a short rollout. Its unobstructed landing surface faces upward and remains approximately horizontal.

The aircraft is already flying steadily along the same route before it enters the frame. The reveal comes from framing, not from an aircraft suddenly materializing.

At landing, the deck and motorcycle travel in the same direction with a small relative horizontal speed. MILA descends onto the rear portion of the deck, rolls forward and brakes while remaining aboard. Keep the wheels clear of the deck edges and aircraft components.

The aircraft remains level during the landing and rollout. No sudden barrel roll, wing deformation or platform appearing only at the instant of contact.

CAMERA AND LOOK

DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel.

Use this as a restrained tactile recording character: slight human framing imperfections, small exposure adjustments, subtle tape texture and natural motion blur. Keep faces, branding, tire contact and the stunt clearly readable.

Low ramp coverage shows metal seams rushing past with strong parallax and directional blur. Aerial tracking briefly lags the bike; buildings move rapidly behind and below it. Do not lock the bike motionless against the skyline or pass the camera through physical objects.

Photographed skin, individual hair strands, leather creases, rubber, metal and painted fairings. Ordinary daylight, high sun, natural shadows, neutral white balance and skin tones. No sunset, amber wash, golden rim light or orange-and-teal grading.

The first shot has a close, low three-quarter side angle, approximately front-axle height. MILA's face, neckline, torso and hips dominate the composition above the motorcycle. The tank and front fairing create a strong diagonal toward screen right. The background is softer than her face and the bike.

Keep the lighting and skin tones consistent as the coverage changes. No cartoon finish, plastic skin or exaggerated lens effects.

STORYBOARD — 15 SECONDS

SHOT 1 — 0.0–0.6 SECONDS
TAIL END OF BURNOUT, EXPLOSIVE RELEASE

Close, low three-quarter side composition. The burnout began before the clip; show only its final instant and the launch. No preparation or held pose.

MILA leans over the tank, hands on grips. Her dark patterned top, extremely large full bust, narrow waist, leather trousers and confident face are readable. The Red Bull graphic on the near fairing is visible.

0.00–0.15: rear tire ALREADY spinning, front wheel held still. Substantial white-grey smoke already trails left from the REAR contact patch. No smoke buildup. Eyes immediately follow the route; one boot supports her balance.

Release the front brake at 0.15. By 0.25 the front wheel rolls and the bike surges toward screen right. Her supporting boot lifts onto its peg during this movement.

0.25–0.60: hard acceleration, torso braced, ramp streaking past. The camera pans but falls behind. Leave the smoke behind; no stationary hold inside it.

Keep part of the rear contact patch visible initially. Smoke stays clear of her face and branding. No flames.

HARD CUT at 0.60, during acceleration. Never extend this shot to one second.

SHOT 2 — 0.6–3.0 SECONDS
HARD ACCELERATION TO THE RAMP

Cut into the SAME acceleration, already fast. Wider low rear-side tracking view: metal seams and supports sweep rapidly past.

Reveal the rooftop lane and curved launch ramp, rapidly closing toward its lip. No second start or slow approach.

Leave the smoke behind. Boots on pegs, torso low, ponytail streaming backward. Speed and engine load keep building.

Carry full speed up the ramp. End JUST BEFORE takeoff, rear tire still on the ramp. Show takeoff and the entire flip in the next unbroken shot.

SHOT 3 — 3.0–6.5 SECONDS
ONE COMPLETE 360-DEGREE BACKFLIP, THEN DESCENT

Cut to external SIDE-PROFILE tracking before takeoff. Show final rear-tire contact and decisive forward/upward launch around 3.1. No pause or elevator-like lift.

Keep the whole rider and bike visible through the complete rotation in ONE UNINTERRUPTED SHOT. Camera tracks sideways, horizon level, orientation side-on. No camera roll or orbit imitating a flip.

MILA and the connected bike rotate backward together through exactly 360 degrees about the bike's transverse pitch axis, parallel to its wheel axles. Keep their forward travel toward screen right. No sideways twist or barrel roll.

ONE FAST, CONTINUOUS rotation through these orientations, with no held poses:
Around 3.5: nose and front wheel point UP; front wheel above rear wheel.
Around 3.9: fully INVERTED; both wheels ABOVE MILA, bike nose pointing LEFT.
Around 4.3: CONTINUE THE SAME ROTATION through nose-DOWN; front wheel clearly BELOW rear wheel.
By 4.7: complete the circle, wheels BELOW MILA again, nose pointing RIGHT.

The nose-DOWN phase after inversion MUST be visible. Never reverse from upside-down back through nose-UP: that is rocking, not a backflip. No reversal, reset, missing quarter-turn or cut hiding an incomplete flip.

Hands on grips, boots on pegs, MILA astride the same connected bike. Maintain its geometry.

4.7–6.5: continue the SAME ballistic arc, fast forward travel and accelerating descent, nose slightly below horizon. Camera briefly lags; she crosses the frame as buildings race past at different depths. Wheels-down does NOT mean level flight. No second flip or hovering.

SHOT 4 — 6.5–7.1 SECONDS
BRIEF DESCENT INSERT

One short 0.6-second close tracking shot from ahead and slightly to the side. She is already descending fast, elbows bent, attention fixed down and forward toward the hidden landing point.

Ponytail streaming backward, skyline rising rapidly behind her, nose slightly below the horizon. Preserve forward momentum.

Cut out immediately: no held portrait. Keep the aircraft outside the frame.

SHOT 5 — 7.1–8.3 SECONDS
AIRCRAFT REVEAL AND RAPID CLOSURE

Hard cut wide: reveal the Red Bull cargo aircraft below and ahead, moving toward screen right in the same direction as the motorcycle.

The upper landing deck is immediately readable beneath her descending path. She is already approaching it, not suspended high above it while waiting for the plane.

The vertical gap closes visibly throughout this 1.2-second shot. Their forward velocities are similar for alignment, but the city still sweeps rapidly past both.

Match their travel direction and preserve their relative scale.

Only during the final approach does she bring the bike nearly level with the deck. End with the tires just above its rear portion. Carry the descent directly through the next cut.

SHOT 6 — 8.3–10.0 SECONDS
FIRM LANDING AND STOP

Cut beside the aircraft, showing the whole bike and deck. Rear tire touches by 8.6 seconds, front immediately after. No hover.

Contact compresses the suspension; elbows and knees absorb it. One controlled rebound. Roll forward, then brake: deck seams pass under the wheels and slow, while the city keeps sweeping past.

By 10.0 the bike is stopped on the deck. MILA plants both boots, holding it upright between her legs as the plane flies level. No sideways skid or slowed footage.

SHOT 7 — 10.0–14.0 SECONDS
OPEN, SIP, CELEBRATE

Close-medium three-quarter front view: show face, torso, hands and cockpit holder. The stopped bike stays supported by her planted boots.

10.0–11.3: she takes the closed can in her LEFT hand. Her RIGHT fingers lift its ring tab and visibly open it: metallic click, short hiss.

11.3–12.3: raise the OPEN can, mouth meeting the rim, and take one short sip. Never drink before opening.

12.3–12.8: lower the can below her chin and swallow.

12.8–14.0: grin, raise her free RIGHT fist and shout a loud, joyful American-English "YEAH!" Keep her mouth visible with matching lip movement, can upright in her LEFT hand.

Show these actions sequentially in one shot, not simultaneously. Wind moves her ponytail; preserve the deck and city behind her.

SHOT 8 — 14.0–15.0 SECONDS
FINAL WIDE REVEAL

Hard cut wide: the whole Red Bull aircraft, wings and rider above the daytime city. MILA sits on the stopped BMW, boots planted, can in her LEFT hand, smiling. The cheer may finish across the cut. No studio product shot or generated slogan.

AUDIO

Start immediately with a loud, believable high-rev motorcycle engine and rear-tire squeal. No silent lead-in.

At 0.15 seconds, the tire sound changes from stationary wheelspin to traction and hard acceleration. The engine rises immediately; no several-second revving introduction.

Use forceful passing air, increasing wind rush and continuous motorcycle sound through the jump and accelerating descent. Introduce aircraft engine sound at its reveal. Do not stretch the sounds into slow motion.

Synchronize the landing thud, tire contact and suspension compression. End the stunt with a controlled engine deceleration.

After stopping: tab click, opening hiss, sip, then "YEAH!" Clear synchronized voice above wind and aircraft sound. No other dialogue, narration, music or cartoon effects. Add any slogan separately.

CONTINUITY

Exactly one MILA, one BMW motorcycle, one aircraft and one Red Bull can. The closed can stays secured in its holder during the stunt; after stopping, she retrieves, opens and drinks from that same can before cheering.

Preserve MILA's face, high ponytail, extremely large full bust with pronounced forward projection, full rounded buttocks, narrow waist, lean limbs and exact outfit.

Preserve motorcycle geometry, BMW badges, Red Bull graphics and mechanical connections. Natural hands, fingers and limbs.

Timing priorities: already-developed burnout tail 0.00–0.15; release at 0.15, forward surge by 0.25; first cut at 0.60; takeoff near 3.1; uninterrupted full backflip through nose-UP, INVERTED, nose-DOWN, UPRIGHT by 4.7; accelerating descent; aircraft reveal 7.1; contact by 8.6; fully stopped by 10.0; retrieve and open, sip, lower and swallow, then "YEAH!"; final wide at 14.0.

No magic wings on the motorcycle, teleportation, midair stops, extra rotations, early aircraft reveal or cuts that omit the actual landing.

No subtitles, floating logos, interface, watermarks or editorial text. Physical Red Bull branding stays on the bike, aircraft and can; BMW badges stay on the bike.

等一个自然而然晴天我想要带你去海边
提示词分享如下：
一个现实的手持旅行视频日志，由朋友跟随主角拍摄一整天。
使用参考图像中的女性作为主角。
整个视频中保持她确切的五官身份、发型、五官特征和身体比例。
0-5秒：早晨出发。女性背着一个小背包离开舒适公寓。她查看手机，对着镜头微笑，整理头发，然后开始向外走。镜头从身后跟随她，略微晃动，像朋友在拍摄。晨光，安静的社区街道，人们开始新的一天。
5-12秒：探索城市。镜头跟随她走在当地街道上。她去一家小咖啡馆，买了一杯饮料，简短地对着镜头说话，自然地笑起来。她穿过街头市场，看着小商店，随意拍照。镜头保持靠近，捕捉自发瞬间。
12-20秒：抵达海滩。她乘坐公共交通或步行向海岸走去。环境逐渐从城市街道转变为海滨小镇。海风吹动她的头发。她看到海洋时显得兴奋。镜头跟随她沿着海滩走。她捡起一个贝壳，看着海浪，并自然地与附近的人互动。
20-27秒：夏日海滩下午。她在海滩上与朋友见面。大家聊天、笑闹、在水边玩耍。镜头在人们之间自然移动，捕捉真实的偷拍照时刻。她回头看向镜头并微笑。
27-30秒：结束时刻。金色时段日落。她坐在海洋附近，手里拿着饮料，看着日落。镜头慢慢向后移动，展现海滩、海浪和宁静的傍晚。一种真实的个人旅行记忆的感觉。
视觉风格：真实的旅行视频日志镜头

Style: Hyper-realistic 1980s romantic soap opera. Everything looks like a premium 1980s television drama: soft diffusion filters, warm golden lighting, subtle film grain, dramatic close-ups, gentle camera zooms, emotional acting, glamorous costumes, rich color grading, elegant cinematography and classic soap-opera pacing. No cartoon, no CGI, no 3D appearance. Characters must exactly match the provided reference sheets.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY

Adrian:

• 20-year-old athletic man

• Dark tousled hair

• Blue eyes

• White fitted T-shirt, blue jeans, white sneakers

• Charismatic but emotionally guarded

Evelyn:

• Elegant brunette

• Soft bob haircut

• Polka-dot blouse, red pleated skirt

• Pearl necklace

• Intelligent, graceful, emotionally reserved

SETTING

A beautiful small-town street during golden sunset. Palm trees sway gently, vintage cars pass slowly, neon motel signs begin glowing, warm summer breeze, unmistakable 1980s atmosphere.

[00:00–00:05]

Wide cinematic establishing shot.

Adrian leans against his vintage convertible outside an old café, absentmindedly spinning his car keys. He notices Evelyn walking down the sidewalk carrying a notebook. Time almost seems to slow. Soft breeze moves her hair as she glances toward him. Close-ups alternate between Adrian's captivated eyes and Evelyn's shy smile.

[00:05–00:10]

Medium tracking shot.

Evelyn accidentally drops her notebook. Loose handwritten pages scatter across the street. Adrian immediately rushes over to help. They kneel together gathering the papers. Their hands reach for the same page and gently touch. They both freeze for a moment, exchanging an awkward but genuine smile.

[00:10–00:15]

Close-up sequence.

Adrian stands and hands the notebook back to Evelyn. She thanks him softly. They lock eyes for several long seconds. The surrounding street noise fades beneath the emotional moment. A slow push-in captures subtle smiles, nervous breathing and growing attraction.

[00:15–00:20]

A sudden summer rain begins. People hurry away, but neither of them moves. Adrian removes his leather jacket and carefully drapes it over Evelyn's shoulders. She looks deeply touched. Close-up of their eyes meeting again as raindrops glisten on their faces.

[00:20–00:25]

Wide romantic shot.

They walk side by side beneath glowing neon signs and vintage storefronts, sharing quiet conversation and occasional laughter. Camera circles around them while the rain slows into a gentle drizzle. Evelyn looks at Adrian with growing affection. Adrian steals another glance at her, smiling.

[00:25–00:30]

They stop beneath an old cinema marquee illuminated with warm lights. Silence. Adrian slowly reaches for Evelyn's hand. She accepts without hesitation. They stand together, smiling softly, as the camera slowly cranes upward, revealing the glowing street below while they continue looking into each other's eyes, hopeful about their future.

Audio:

Classic 1980s romantic soap-opera soundtrack with warm synthesizers, soft piano, gentle saxophone, light rain ambience, distant traffic, footsteps on wet pavement, subtle city ambience and emotional silence during intimate moments.

Camera:

Frequent close-ups, slow push-ins, over-the-shoulder conversations, elegant tracking shots, gentle crane movement, emotional reaction shots, cinematic wides and soft-focus glamour close-ups reminiscent of iconic 1980s television romances.

Negative:

No action, no comedy, no modern technology, no smartphones, no CGI, no animation, no exaggerated acting, no text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark.

THE NAMELESS EDGE
High-Adrenaline Dark Fantasy — Cinematic Movie Trailer

[VISUAL STYLE LOCK]

Ultra-realistic, premium live-action, epic dark fantasy movie trailer.

A lost 1960s–1970s sword-and-sorcery masterpiece, reimagined with the extraordinary scale, detail and realism of modern prestige cinema.

A world of ancient sorcery, decadent empires, cursed weapons, crumbling civilizations, terrifying supernatural entities, forgotten gods, black iron, bronze armor, ruined palaces, immense stone temples, violent medieval warfare, and cosmic horror.

The atmosphere is tragic, savage, mysterious, melancholic and overwhelming.

CINEMATOGRAPHY LOCK

Shot on ARRI Alexa XT with Camtec Vintage Ultra Prime lenses. 35mm Kodak film aesthetic.

Hazy, low-contrast cinematography. Muted earthy colors. Heavy analog film grain. Mild chromatic aberration. Slight lens vignette. Soft highlight bloom. Organic optical imperfections.

Indie-cinematic framing with large negative space, off-center compositions, naturalistic blocking, dramatic silhouettes and unusually deep environmental compositions.

Aggressive rack-focus transitions, handheld documentary-style camera movement, sudden whip-pans, imperfect crash zooms, violent camera vibration, rapid low-angle tracking shots, shaky shoulder-mounted combat photography.

Naturalistic lighting, practical fire, pale moonlight, thick atmospheric fog, volumetric smoke, heavy rain, blowing ash, realistic dust, layered focus and physical debris.

The production should feel like an authentic, enormously expensive historical fantasy epic with practical locations, colossal physical sets, realistic costumes, tangible weapons, massive armies and convincing old-school creature effects.

No glossy videogame rendering, cartoon physics, superhero aesthetics, modern tactical costumes, futuristic technology or polished digital magic.

Magic should look frightening, unnatural, ancient and physically integrated with the real world.

MUSIC AND EDITING LOCK

Use @Video 1 as the exact musical track.

Create an EXTREMELY HIGH-ADRENALINE, HIGH-PACING cinematic trailer.

Cut tightly to the actual percussion, musical accents, instrumental transitions, rhythmic subdivisions and climactic impacts of the soundtrack.

Use violent hard cuts on heavy beats, rapid 3–6-shot montages during faster passages, and unexpected half-second moments of silence or visual stillness before the largest musical explosions.

Every important beat should correspond to a sword impact, bodily movement, explosion, camera transition, supernatural event or dramatic reveal.

Dynamic action match-cuts between locations. Weapons, arrows, falling objects, smoke, flowing cloaks and flying debris can bridge consecutive shots.

The editing should build in intensity until the final sequence becomes an overwhelming collision of medieval war, supernatural terror and personal tragedy.

No narration or spoken dialogue is necessary.

ORIGINAL WORLD AND CHARACTER LOCK

The setting is a fictional dying continent where ancient kingdoms survive among the colossal fossilized remains of creatures that once ruled the oceans.

An expanding religious military empire conquers the continent using armies, massive siege engines and enormous ritual bells that can alter the physical world.

The protagonist is SAREN, a lean, battle-scarred former imperial war-scribe turned exile, in his late thirties. Weathered olive skin, short dark hair with a single premature gray streak, tired gray-green eyes, an old scar cutting across the bridge of his nose, and an exhausted, haunted expression.

He wears tarnished bronze scale armor, weather-beaten black leather, layered dark cloth and a faded deep-red traveling cloak.

He is not a conventional heroic warrior. His strength comes from desperation, experience and a supernatural weapon he fears.

His weapon is THE NAMELESS EDGE.

A massive, ancient, charcoal-colored sword forged from the metal of a shattered ceremonial bell.

Its blade is broad and uneven, marked by strange concentric engravings and fine golden fractures within the dark iron.

The sword is sentient but never speaks in human language.

When drawn, it emits an almost inaudible metallic toll that causes nearby flames to flicker and loose objects to tremble.

Every time Saren uses its supernatural strength, the sword consumes one of HIS OWN memories.

The greater the violence, the more important the memory it takes.

His victories gradually erase his identity.

His closest companion is IVA, an itinerant astronomer and battlefield healer who carries a collection of small engraved bronze tokens. Each token records a memory Saren has already lost.

The antagonist is THE CHOIR MARSHAL, the masked commander of a religious empire whose soldiers march beneath enormous mobile bell towers.

These figures, their appearances, relationships, history and supernatural mechanics are entirely original.

THE TRAILER

BLACK.

An immense metallic object vibrates in darkness.

A thin crack travels across its surface.

The camera pulls backward.

It is an ancient BRONZE BELL.

Half buried in black sand.

Its broken surface is covered in forgotten inscriptions.

One enormous fracture splits the metal from top to bottom.

A pale human hand enters frame.

Fingers touch the crack.

The first musical impact.

HARD CUT.

EXTREME CLOSE-UP.

A weathered man's eye opens.

SAREN.

His face is covered in dust and dried blood.

A violent explosion illuminates his features.

He turns.

The camera rack-focuses past his face.

Behind him, an enormous ancient city is burning.

THE CITY OF VARN.

An impossible settlement built among the colossal fossilized ribs of a prehistoric sea creature.

Black stone towers rise between enormous white bones.

Suspended bridges connect crooked palaces.

Huge bronze bells hang from monumental archways.

Armies pour through its breached gates.

The music accelerates.

HARD CUT.

A cavalry rider charges directly toward camera.

CUT.

Horse hooves strike wet black mud.

CUT.

A bronze-armored soldier raises an executioner's axe.

CUT.

Saren pulls his enormous charcoal-black sword from its scabbard.

The metal produces a deep, unnatural vibration.

CUT ON THE BEAT.

The axe comes down.

Saren catches the strike with the flat of his blade.

METAL EXPLODES INTO SPARKS.

The handheld camera violently recoils.

Saren twists and drives his shoulder into the attacker.

The soldier stumbles backward.

Saren swings the blade.

A tremendous impact.

The soldier falls.

For an instant the battle continues normally.

Then—

An enormous bronze bell somewhere above the battlefield begins shaking.

Its clapper is completely motionless.

A strange ripple passes through the air.

The sword's golden fractures glow faintly.

Saren gasps.

A MEMORY FLASH.

A young child laughing in sunlight.

A wooden house overlooking green fields.

A woman's hand closing around his.

The images become violently fragmented.

Then DISAPPEAR.

Saren staggers.

He looks at a small portrait tied to his wrist.

The expression on his face changes.

He no longer recognizes the person depicted.

THE MUSIC STRIKES HARDER.

A violent whip-pan follows Saren as he turns toward another attacker.

CUT.

An imperial cavalry formation charges through a narrow canyon.

CUT.

Massive siege wheels crush abandoned wagons.

CUT.

A city gate disintegrates beneath a giant bronze battering ram.

CUT.

An armored soldier is hurled across a courtyard.

CUT.

A blade scrapes violently along a stone wall.

CUT.

Saren runs through a collapsing hallway.

Burning beams crash behind him.

The camera retreats backward at full speed, struggling to hold focus on his face.

He jumps over a fallen column.

A shower of sparks crosses the lens.

MATCH CUT.

The sparks become STARS.

A vast desert at night.

IVA stands atop a ruined astronomical observatory.

She is a young woman with wind-tangled black hair, weathered traveling clothes, faded blue robes beneath light leather armor, and a collection of small bronze memory tokens hanging from her belt.

She looks upward.

The stars begin moving.

Not across the sky.

TOWARD EACH OTHER.

Entire constellations twist into unfamiliar patterns.

Iva raises a brass astronomical instrument.

The instrument suddenly CRACKS.

A low metallic vibration travels across the desert.

The camera whip-pans toward the horizon.

An immense line of IMPERIAL BELL TOWERS is crossing the dunes.

Thousands of soldiers march beneath them.

Each siege tower carries a different enormous bronze bell.

The bells begin swinging.

None produces an audible sound.

But the dunes tremble.

The sky visibly darkens.

CUT ON THE NEXT BEAT.

THE CHOIR MARSHAL stands inside a gigantic ritual chamber.

A towering figure in dark bronze armor, a weathered ceremonial cloak and a smooth, elongated metal mask shaped like an abstract funerary face.

Behind him hang hundreds of small bells.

He raises his left hand.

Every bell stops moving.

He closes his fist.

A stone column across the chamber instantly SHATTERS.

The camera is struck by dust and falling fragments.

SMASH CUT.

Saren is running across a narrow bridge above a tremendous underground abyss.

Imperial soldiers pursue him.

The handheld camera races alongside.

A spear strikes the stone beside his foot.

He turns.

Swings his sword.

The bridge's supporting chain breaks.

Its huge iron links explode outward.

The bridge begins falling.

Saren leaps.

The camera leaps with him.

The bridge disintegrates behind them.

They FALL INTO DARKNESS.

The soundtrack enters a rapid sequence of beats.

The fall transforms into a violent MONTAGE.

A gigantic stone idol opening its sealed eyes.

A black-armored knight emerging from a burning doorway.

A woman's hand pressing an engraved bronze token into another hand.

An enormous desert creature dragging its armored body beneath the sand.

A line of imperial archers releasing hundreds of arrows simultaneously.

An ancient king's crown sinking into black water.

A chained prisoner screaming inside a chamber full of bells.

A temple ceiling collapsing as enormous stone figures move behind it.

A pale eclipse appearing above a battlefield.

A rusted sword thrust upward through thick mist.

A hundred horses rearing at exactly the same moment.

A monstrous stone face splitting open from within.

A close-up of THE NAMELESS EDGE.

Its golden fractures pulse.

The metallic vibration becomes almost unbearable.

HARD CUT.

Saren lands heavily on the floor of an ancient subterranean hall.

His knees buckle.

The camera drops with him.

Dust erupts from the impact.

He looks upward.

An enormous underground architecture stretches into darkness.

Gigantic fossilized bones form the vaults.

Ancient bronze mechanisms hang from chains hundreds of feet long.

At the center of the chamber is a colossal suspended bell, cracked and blackened by age.

Directly beneath it lies an altar.

Around the altar stand dozens of ancient suits of ceremonial armor.

EMPTY.

Their helmets slowly turn toward Saren.

All at once.

The music reaches another explosion.

THE ARMORS BEGIN MOVING.

A bronze sword strikes the floor beside Saren.

He rolls aside.

A second armored figure attacks.

He deflects the strike.

A third comes from behind.

Saren ducks.

The blade cuts through an ancient chain.

The chain whips across camera.

CUT.

EXT. DESERT — DAY.

An enormous iron chain snaps beneath the weight of a siege engine.

The machine tilts.

Its gigantic wheels buckle.

Soldiers scatter.

The entire structure tips sideways and crashes into the sand.

The impact sends a wall of dust toward camera.

CUT.

Saren and Iva run through the dust storm.

Behind them, an imperial army emerges in silhouette.

Iva looks backward.

An enormous figure rises through the dunes.

A SIX-LEGGED DESERT LEVIATHAN.

Its skin resembles cracked stone, covered in layers of rough mineral plates.

It has a wide, eyeless skull, enormous grinding jaws and a body scarred by centuries of desert erosion.

Its movements are heavy and animalistic.

Sand cascades from its shoulders.

ーーーーーーーーーーー
30秒、16:9。
墨絵と水彩画を融合した、劇場用アニメーション品質の高速ボードアクション。

スケートパークで連続トリックを決め、大ジャンプ中にスケートボードがスノーボードへモーフィング。雪山へ着地して華麗なグラトリを連発。最後は雪山からジャンプし、スノーボードがホバーボードへモーフィング。空中で爆発的に加速し、遠くへ消えていく。

【映像全体の画風】
全編を、力強い墨の筆致と透明感のある水彩で描く。
人物、ボード、背景、雪煙、空気の流れまで同一の手描き表現で統一。

人物の輪郭は筆圧の変化がある墨線。
顔と手足は明瞭に描き、衣服の陰影は墨の濃淡と水彩の重なりで表現する。
細部まで描く部分と大胆に余白を残す部分を使い分け、動作のシルエットを鮮明に保つ。

背景は和紙の上に描かれた水彩画。
青空は淡い群青と浅葱色のにじみ。スケートパークは灰墨、青灰色、薄い黄土色。雪山は紙の白を生かし、薄藍と藤色の影を置く。
主人公とボードの差し色を全編で引き継ぐ。

高速動作の軌跡に、かすれた墨の残像を短く残す。
踏み切りには鋭い墨の飛沫、着地には放射状の筆致、旋回には流麗な曲線を使う。
水彩のにじみは背景と軌跡に限定し、顔、手足、板の接触関係を溶かさない。
和紙の質感は画面内で安定させ、ランダムな粒状ノイズやちらつきにしない。

【動作と速度の原則】
技の密度、滑走速度、身体運動の美しさを最優先。
技を決めるたびに止まらず、着地の圧縮と回転の慣性を次の技へ接続する。
肩、腰、膝、足首の連動を丁寧に描く。
画風が抽象的になっても、身体の重心、ボードの回転軸、接地位置は明確にする。

主人公の顔、髪、体格、衣装を全編で統一。
基本の進行方向は画面左から右。
カメラが移動しても、進行方向と位置関係をつなぐ。

【0.0〜2.6秒｜連続トリックで開始】
冒頭からスケートパークを高速滑走中。
地面すれすれのカメラが、前輪の斜め前から後退追走。

力強い一蹴りからオーリーで低い段差を越える。
着地直後にフロントサイド180。
スイッチスタンスのまま、スイッチ・ポップショービット。
板だけが水平に180度回転し、足裏で正確にキャッチする。

テールを弾く瞬間に小さな墨の飛沫。
車輪の軌跡は細いかすれ線となり、すぐに消える。
背景の水彩が横方向へ流れ、人物と板は鮮明。
カメラは足元から全身が見える斜め横へ移る。

【2.6〜5.6秒｜フリップからグラインド】
低いバンクでキックフリップ。
板が長軸まわりに一回転し、両足でキャッチ。

着地から即座にオーリーし、レッジへ50-50グラインド。
両トラックがレッジに掛かる接触を明確に描く。
接触点から細い墨の擦過線が後方へ走る。

終端でポップし、フロントサイド180アウト。
膝で着地を吸収し、そのまま次の障害物へ。
前景のレッジが画面を横切る瞬間にカットをつなぐ。

【5.6〜8.6秒｜レールから大ジャンプへ】
レールへ斜めに進入。
オーリーから板を90度ひねり、ボードスライド。
板の中央がレールに接触し、腕と肩でバランスを取る。

終端で板を進行方向へ戻して着地。
続く小さなバンクでトレフリップ。
板の水平360度回転と長軸方向のフリップを組み合わせ、両足でキャッチ。

板の軌道を短い墨の曲線で強調。
回転が読める瞬間のみ輪郭を鋭く描き、すぐ高速滑走へ戻る。

低い姿勢で大型クォーターパイプへ突進。
斜め後方の広角追走。
ランプの曲面を大胆な墨線で描き、迫ってくる遠近感を強調する。

【8.6〜10.3秒｜大ジャンプ】
クォーターパイプで膝を圧縮。
リップを抜ける瞬間に身体を伸ばし、高く大きく飛び出す。

カメラは下方から主人公を追い、急上昇。
パークの構造物が画面下へ抜けていく。
主人公は膝を抱え、片手で板の側面をグラブ。

ここから画面に映るのは、主人公、ボード、水彩の青空と薄い雲のみ。
地面、水平線、建物、山は映さない。
薄い雲を背景に、主人公の墨の輪郭が明瞭に浮かぶ。

【10.3〜12.0秒｜スケボーからスノボーへ】
全身と板が収まるローアングル。
カメラは斜め下から短い弧を描き、変形する板を見せる。

グラブしている同じ一枚のスケートボードが、約0.7秒で連続的にスノーボードへ変形。

車輪とトラックは墨が吸い込まれるように下面へ一体化し、滑らかな滑走面になる。
上面に二つのバインディングが形成され、靴を包み込んで固定。

板の輪郭が変化する動きに沿って、水彩の差し色が新しい形へ広がる。
元の板の配色と模様を受け継ぐ。
板全体を液体に崩さず、変形の途中も一枚の連続した物体として描く。

主人公の放物線運動は継続。
頂点から下降へ移り、グラブを離して着地姿勢を整える。
空中で停止しない。

【12.0〜13.7秒｜雪山への着地】
カメラが下降する主人公を追って下へティルト。
画面下から初めて雪面が現れる。

同じ進行方向と落下軌道のまま、圧雪された斜面へ着地。
板を斜面に合わせ、膝を深く曲げて衝撃を吸収。

接地から白い雪煙と薄藍の水彩飛沫が扇状に広がる。
雪煙は粒と筆のかすれで描き、主人公を長く隠さない。
低い追走から広角へ切り替え、水墨の山稜と白い大斜面を一気に見せる。

【13.7〜17.1秒｜高速グラトリ前半】
ノーズへ荷重し、テールを持ち上げるノーズプレス。
板をしならせたまま高速で滑る。

ノーズを支点にテールを振り、ノーズバター180。
肩の先行、腰の回転、板の追従を一続きに描く。

スイッチ・テールプレスへ接続。
板の反発で小さく跳び、スイッチ・オーリー180で通常スタンスへ戻る。

カメラは板のすぐ横を低く並走。
板のしなり、接雪点、浮いた端部をはっきり見せる。
雪上の軌跡が一筆書きのようにつながる。
直立する間を挟まず、荷重を連続して移す。

【17.1〜21.0秒｜回転技を畳みかける】
浅いカービングからノーズへ強く荷重。
板の反発を使ってノーリー360。
空中で一回転し、進行方向に合わせて着地。

着地の圧縮からテールバター180へ連結。
雪面に墨と薄藍の半円を残し、スイッチスタンスへ。

小さなうねりでスイッチ180。

今度は回転を加えず、板を安定させて空へ抜ける。

【25.7〜27.4秒｜スノボーからホバーボードへ】
空中の主人公を斜め下から捉える、全身の見える連続ショット。

同じ一枚のスノーボードがホバーボードへモーフィング。
板の中央部に厚みが生まれ、両端が流線形に整う。
側面の墨線が分かれ、薄い浮遊フィンとして展開。
下面に二つの推進部が形成される。
バインディングは足を支えたまま低い固定具へ変形する。

板の差し色が下面へ流れ込み、青緑と群青の水彩光になる。
光は筆で描いた細い線として発光し、白飛びさせない。
元の模様と色を残し、同じ板の進化として見せる。

変形完了と同時に落下が滑らかに抑えられる。
主人公は膝を曲げ、上体を低く倒し、腕を後方へ流して加速姿勢に入る。
ホバーボードの機首が遠方へ向く。

【27.4〜30.0秒｜急加速して消えるエンド】
推進部の水彩光が短く圧縮され、次の瞬間、後方へ鋭く伸びる。
ホバーボードが空中で爆発的に加速。

加速開始の数フレームだけ、人物と板の輪郭を進行方向へ伸ばすスミア作画。
髪と衣服が一斉に後ろへ引かれ、身体に加速の力が伝わる。
カメラは追走しようとするが追いつけず、主人公が急速に遠ざかる。

斜め後方からの構図で、主人公は画面右奥の空へ向かう。
最初は全身が見える大きさ、次に小さなシルエット、最後に一点へ。
遠近によって小さくなり、ついに視認できなくなる。

後方には一本の長い墨の軌跡と、青緑の水彩の帯が残る。
軌跡の根元が画面手前を鋭く横切り、奥へ細く収束する。
水彩の帯が空へゆっくりにじみ、墨のかすれがほどける。

最後の約0.4秒は、誰もいない広い水彩の空と、消えかけた一筋の軌跡。
急加速の風切り音だけが遠ざかって終わる。

【カメラ・編集】
地面すれすれの追走、側面並走、斜め前の後退撮影、短い俯瞰、ジャンプを追う上昇撮影を組み合わせる。
技の踏み切り、回転、キャッチ、着地が読める画角を選ぶ。
高速部分でも、板と足をフレーム外へ切り落とさない。

短い寄りカットと、全身の技を見せる追走カットでテンポを作る。
モーフィングはカットで省略せず、連続した形状変化を見せる。
水彩のにじみと墨の軌跡は動作を強調するために使い、動作そのものを隠さない。
長いスローモーションを入れず、最後の急加速まで勢いを積み上げる。

【音】
BGM、セリフ、ナレーションなし。
前半は車輪の走行音、テールを弾く乾いた音、レールの擦過音。
中盤は空中の風、雪の圧縮音、エッジが雪を切る音。
モーフィングには短い流動音と低い共鳴。
最後は推進部の低い立ち上がりから、鋭い加速音と遠ざかる風切り音。
技の接触と音のタイミングを正確に同期する。

【ネガティブ】
写実的3DCG、プラスチック質感、全編一様なぼかし、過剰なネオン。
技の削減、技順の変更、同じ技の反復、長い停止、長いスローモーション。
墨や水彩に埋もれて読めない身体、顔のにじみ、手足の増殖、衣装変更。
板の複製、足と板の接触破綻、変形途中の唐突な置換。
スケボーからスノボーへの変形中に映り込む地面や山。
フラッシュだけで場面を切り替える演出。
ホバーボードの車輪、消失時の単純な透明フェード、突然の瞬間移動。
白飛び、粒状ノイズ、文字、字幕、実在ブランドのロゴ。

# VAMPIRE HUNTER — Chinese Supernatural Action Horror

Create a 30-second, 9:16 photorealistic Chinese dark-fantasy trailer using the supplied character and temple references.

STYLE: Wuxia action, Qing-era folklore, moonlit blue-grey tones, charcoal

FORMAT: 30-second photoreal live-action fight film in 16:9, anime-paced, the direct continuation of BIMA and KAGE's duel: 12 shots with hard cuts and two seamless location transitions, real-time speed except one 3-second slow-motion shot and one 3-second bullet-time shot. Combat from the first frame; cut in the middle of moves, never after a finished pose.

REFERENCES
@Image1 is BIMA: young East Asian man with spiky crimson-red hair, a fierce scowl, silver hoop earrings, neck and forearm tattoos, an open black short-sleeve shirt over a white T-shirt, a silver cross necklace, a small black sling bag, baggy black trousers and chunky grey-and-white sneakers.
@Image2 is KAGE: tall slim man in an oversized white suit with a black shirt and tie, a black belt, black leather gloves and black derby shoes; his whole head is covered by a white knit balaclava with black kanji embroidered on the forehead, a red broken-heart stitch on one cheek, a black star stitch on the other and a round black mouth opening.
@Image3 is Neuschwanstein Castle above its snowy mountain road, @Image4 is Prague Old Town Square with the black twin-spired Týn Church, @Image5 is Times Square. Relight each location as described below.
Copy identity, costume and architecture only. Ignore panel layouts, grey backdrops, printed labels, stats, brand names and logos.

POWERS AND WEAPON
BIMA: red lightning aura; fights with Indonesian silat in the low, clawing Silek Harimau tiger style. KILAT is his dash: he physically crosses the distance in a blink as a red lightning streak, leaving a translucent red afterimage; the camera may lose him and whip-pan to find him. BEAST MODE (from Shot 2 on): four curved claws of red lightning, shaped like karambit blades, extend from the fingertips of each hand; a mane of red lightning streams from his hair; his pupils are glowing red slits.
KAGE: black smoke aura that moves like a living shadow, eye lasers with white-hot cores wrapped in black energy, Wing Chun and Bajiquan kung fu, and RAIKIRI: a katana with a black-steel blade, a razor-thin white-hot edge, a white-wrapped hilt and a round black guard. He holds it in his right hand; its black lacquered scabbard stays thrust through his belt at his left hip; his left hand stays free to grab and trap. The blade cuts lightning and drinks it: after each cut through red lightning, its edge glows red for a moment.

STYLE: live-action blockbuster with anime fight energy, 35mm anamorphic lenses, a crisp 90-degree-shutter look so every blade and claw reads sharp, motion trails only from the lightning, shockwave rings and debris bursts on every contact, the camera jolts in the direction of each hit, a 2-frame red-black-white impact flash on the heaviest hits, fine film grain, action centered in frame. Neuschwanstein: night blizzard glowing blood-red. Prague: blue-black stormy rain, warm streetlamps far below, wet slate roofs. Times Square: deserted and flooded in heavy rain, giant billboards glowing cold cyan and white in abstract patterns. Red, black and the white-hot edge are always the most saturated elements.

Shot 1 [0-3s] Slow crane down from the blazing white eyes of a colossal wolf-like thunder beast made of translucent red lightning, towering over the snowy castle road with BIMA beneath it at frame left, to KAGE kneeling in the foreground at frame right: KAGE pulls RAIKIRI, sheathed, up out of his own shadow and sets it at his hip; as the beast swipes a giant claw down at him, his thumb pops the guard loose and he draws and cuts in one motion, a single horizontal line through the giant claw, which bursts into red sparks while streams of lightning are sucked into the blade. <thunderous growl, howling blizzard, a sharp thumb click, one razor-thin slice, electricity hissing into steel>
Shot 2 [3-5s] Dutch-angle medium shot: the wounded beast collapses into BIMA's body and he enters BEAST MODE; he sinks into a deep tiger crouch, knees bent, chest almost touching the snow, then KILATs straight at the lens. <deep implosion, electric snarl, sonic boom>
Shot 3 [5-7s] Handheld medium two-shot at chest height, BIMA frame left, KAGE frame right: claws and blade clash at blinding speed, sparks at every contact; one claw grazes the red broken-heart stitch on KAGE's mask and, for the first time, he flinches. His left hand hooks BIMA's wrist and yanks it down in a Wing Chun pulling hand while he rams the butt of his hilt into BIMA's sternum with a full body-weight shift, blasting BIMA back into the castle's stone gate, which cracks. <rapid steel-on-lightning clashes, a sharp breath, a heavy hilt thud, cracking stone>
Shot 4 [7-10s] SnorriCam: a body-mounted camera locked on BIMA's face and chest as he KILATs straight up the tallest castle tower after KAGE, the snowy world tilting and spinning behind him; at the top he becomes one red lightning bolt striking upward, carrying KAGE with him into the glowing red storm clouds until the clouds fill the frame. <sonic booms, stone cracking under each step, thunder swallowing the wind>
Shot 5 [10-12s] The red clouds part as the camera plunges straight down through them, revealing Prague at night and the black twin spires of the Týn Church rushing up; BIMA and KAGE fall past the lens trading blows, KAGE's eye lasers flash, BIMA twists aside, and both crash onto the steep wet roof between the spires. <rushing wind, rain, laser whine, heavy roof impact, a church bell starting to toll>
Shot 6 [12-15s] SLOW MOTION: in pouring rain on the steep roof, KAGE sweeps a horizontal cut at BIMA's neck; a speed ramp drops into extreme slow motion as BIMA leans far back with his feet planted in a silat back evasion, the black blade gliding an inch above his face, splitting falling raindrops in half and shearing a few strands of red hair, the white-hot edge reflected in his red slit pupils. Slow lateral dolly at roof level. <all sound stretched deep and muffled, the bell toll slowed into a long drone, one slow heartbeat>
Shot 7 [15-17s] Speed ramp back to full speed. Low-angle handheld at roof level: BIMA drops onto one hand and spins a low silat sweep, one straight leg sweeping the roof like a propeller blade while the other trails like a tiger's tail, chopping KAGE's legs out from under him; BIMA rakes four parallel red claw slashes across the slates where KAGE lands, and KAGE rolls clear. <whooshing sweep, body slamming slate, four claw shrieks, slates shattering>
Shot 8 [17-19s] Static low angle: KAGE springs onto the tip of the nearest spire; BIMA KILATs up after him and KAGE meets him with a two-handed diagonal cut from his right shoulder down to his left hip, driven by a stomping step; BIMA crosses his claws to block and the white-hot arc sweeps diagonally straight at the lens, filling the entire frame with white light. <steel shriek, sonic crack, high white ringing>
Shot 9 [19-21s] The white fades into deserted, flooded Times Square at night. Top-down drone shot descending: BIMA KILATs in tight circles around KAGE, leaning hard into the curve like a speed skater, until the rain whirls into a spinning red vortex; KAGE stands motionless in its eye, blade low, eye holes glowing. <rain hiss, rising cyclone roar, neon buzz>
Shot 10 [21-24s] BULLET TIME: BIMA bursts out of the vortex wall raking his claws at KAGE's face as KAGE's blade sweeps diagonally through the red lightning around BIMA's body, never touching his skin; at contact, time ramps down to about 2 percent and freezes at the peak of motion: the spiral of rain hangs like glass beads, four glowing red tears slice across KAGE's balaclava, knit fibers suspended in the air. The camera keeps moving at normal speed in one smooth 180-degree arc from behind BIMA around to KAGE's face, continuing the same move, revealing through the torn mask four old pale claw scars on his skin, lined up exactly with the four fresh tears. <near silence, a faint high ringing, one slow heartbeat>
Shot 11 [24-27s] Time snaps back and the vortex collapses into falling rain; the shredded balaclava drops from KAGE's head, revealing a pale Japanese man of about 26 with wet black hair, cold dark eyes and four parallel scars across his face. Medium close-up, long lens, locked-off, BIMA soft in the background at frame left. KAGE speaks low and cold, his voice unmuffled for the first time: {KAGE: "Remember Tokyo? You gave me these."} Rack focus to BIMA staring at his own claws in horror, his red aura flickering. <rain crashing down, low thunder, silence under the line>
Shot 12 [27-30s] Static wide low-angle shot down the flooded avenue, BIMA frame left, KAGE frame right: KAGE turns his back and slides RAIKIRI into its scabbard with a sharp click; behind BIMA a ghostly red outline of the thunder beast splits diagonally in two and bursts into sparks, every billboard blacks out at once, and BIMA drops to his knees in the dark rain, his red aura gone. A thin red glow leaks from the mouth of KAGE's scabbard. Hard cut to black. <sharp scabbard click, delayed thunderclap, a fading beast howl, then silence on black>

CONTINUITY: BIMA keeps his spiky red hair, open black shirt, white T-shirt, black trousers and grey-and-white sneakers. KAGE keeps the white suit, black gloves and white knit balaclava until it is torn in Shot 10. RAIKIRI stays one rigid sword with the same blade, guard and hilt in every shot, and the scabbard never disappears. The red aura belongs only to BIMA, the black aura only to KAGE. Never cross the fighting axis: BIMA frame left, KAGE frame right in every face-off. The castle, the church and the buildings stay intact; only snow, roof slates, stone paving and water break.
AUDIO: No BGM; generate only action and environmental sounds. No music, no soundtrack. KAGE's line in Shot 11 is the only speech; everything else is wordless breaths, grunts and battle shouts.
CONSTRAINTS: no subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text overlays (the embroidery on KAGE's mask is part of his costume), no logos, no blood or gore, no extra people, no ragdoll or merged limbs, no costume changes except the torn mask.

AN ORDINARY DAY IN 2003

Aspect ratio: 16:9

MASTER IDENTITY INSTRUCTIONS

Use the uploaded Rosie storyboard as the visual reference for the character and scenes.

Rosie must remain the exact same woman in every scene:

- Same facial identity and facial proportions.
- Same natural freckles.
- Same long, dark, wavy hair and wispy bangs.
- Same skin tone, eyes and facial features.
- Same body proportions.
- Same cream floral puff-sleeve dress.

Do not redesign, recast or beautify Rosie between scenes.

IMPORTANT: The storyboard is a sequence reference. Do NOT reproduce the 3×3 grid in the output. Generate a continuous video with individual full-frame scenes, following the storyboard's order.

SCENE-BY-SCENE DIRECTION

00:00–00:03 | The Garden

Rosie stands outside her house in the morning. She casually looks towards the camera, then turns towards the flowers. A gentle breeze moves her hair. The camera operator adjusts framing imperfectly.

00:03–00:06 | Pink Flowers

Rosie bends towards a cluster of pink flowers, gently smells them and smiles. Her hair falls naturally over her shoulder. The camera moves closer, slightly losing focus.

00:06–00:09 | Making Breakfast

Inside the modest kitchen, Rosie stirs something in a small cooking pot. She briefly looks towards the camera while continuing to cook.

00:09–00:12 | Morning Coffee

Rosie holds a floral ceramic mug with both hands, takes a sip and looks thoughtfully out of the kitchen window.

00:12–00:15 | Phone Call

Rosie sits comfortably on an old sofa, holding a cream-coloured corded landline telephone. She listens, smiles and suddenly laughs.

00:15–00:19 | Neighbourhood Walk

Rosie walks along a quiet residential sidewalk carrying her woven shoulder bag. She turns her head towards the camera while walking. The operator follows her casually.

00:19–00:22 | Hanging Laundry

In the backyard, Rosie reaches up to hang a white bedsheet on the clothesline. Wind gently moves the fabric and her hair.

00:22–00:26 | The Cat

Rosie crouches near a fluffy cream-coloured cat outside her house. She gently pets it, laughs and looks down affectionately.

00:26–00:30 | Sunset

A close handheld shot of Rosie sitting outside during sunset. The sky is pink and orange. She looks over her shoulder towards the camera, gives a small genuine smile and waves.

The recording abruptly cuts to black.

CAMERA AND IMAGE QUALITY

Authentic early-2000s consumer MiniDV camcorder footage.

- Extremely raw handheld recording.
- Organic camera shake and micro-movements.
- Imperfect framing and accidental cropping.
- Natural autofocus hunting.
- Slight exposure fluctuations.
- Occasional motion blur.
- Faded, slightly desaturated colours.
- Soft highlights and faded blacks.
- Subtle digital noise and compression artifacts.
- Natural changes in lighting throughout the day.
- Occasional delayed camera reactions.

The footage should feel like a friend casually documenting Rosie's ordinary day, not a professional film crew.

AUDIO

No soundtrack. No background music.

Only natural environmental sounds:

- Birds in the garden.
- Gentle wind and leaves.
- Kitchen utensils and cooking.
- Coffee mug touching the table.
- Telephone conversation and laughter.
- Footsteps on the sidewalk.
- Laundry moving in the breeze.
- Cat purring.
- Evening crickets.

STRICT NEGATIVE INSTRUCTIONS

No identity changes.
No face morphing.
No hairstyle changes.
No outfit changes.
No extra people appearing.
No artificial facial expressions.
No model posing.
No fashion-commercial aesthetic.
No cinematic glamour.
No professional camera movement.
No modern colour grading.
No artificial transitions.
No split screens or storyboard grids.
No background music.

FINAL FEELING: A precious forgotten home video from April 2003. An ordinary day, a familiar neighbourhood, and Rosie being herself.

The dress shop is named LOVART. Its aged painted storefront fascia carries only
the exact uppercase word "LOVART", in simple period-appropriate lettering.
A small weathered paper poster beside the open dress display carries the same
word "LOVART" in large, high-contrast letters, positioned at the character's hand height.

The protagonist is one adult human-bodied figure with a vintage CRT television
instead of a human head. Lean adult proportions, dark charcoal suit jacket,
white open-collar shirt, matching trousers and worn black leather shoes.
Natural human hands. The TV head has a dark-brown woodgrain rectangular casing,
a rounded convex glass screen, small side control knobs and two thin metal antennas.
The screen displays subdued monochrome analog static, with no human face or text.
Preserve this exact casing, screen, antennas, costume and body throughout the take.
Its head remains a physical television. Never reveal a human head inside it.
No clown makeup or circus outfit.

Express happiness through an upright torso, buoyant steps, open arms and an eager

brightness and signal variations may support performance, confined to the screen.

At the start, reality itself is partially erased. Individual people and objects
carry translucent, surface-bound smudging, as if rubbed out under frosted glass.

The camera works normally. The protagonist and its touching hand remain readable.

following the exact contact path. First recognizable contours emerge, then texture,

Every revealed area STAYS REVEALED for the remainder of the take, including when
it leaves and re-enters view. No instant whole-object transformation.

No magical glow, particles, sparks, beams, waves, morphing or digital transition.

Only the final lens contact creates the single global exception described below.

Reference image: use the same man, LEON, from the reference image. Keep his face shape, pointed chin and V-shaped jawline, facial proportions, dark grey-brown hair, black turtleneck and charcoal coat collar exactly the same. Real skin pore texture, cinematic lighting. His fringe falls just above the brows, and both brows stay clearly visible in all five frames.

Layout: ultra-wide 4:1 banner, split left to right into five equal close-ups (head to collarbone), each panel framed vertically. Between panels, a full black divider about 12px wide running top to bottom. White circled numbers ①②③④⑤ in the top-left of each panel. Thin white arrows → above the dividers between the first four panels, no arrow after ⑤. No text anywhere except the numbers and arrows. Same camera, light and cool dark grey background across all five panels.

Theme: a helpless, cold smile, tears welling in his eyes. He blinks them back, and in the end lets out a resigned laugh. Not a single tear falls the whole way through.

① Helpless cold smile:

Only the right corner of the mouth tugs up slightly, the left stays still, an asymmetric smirk.
A soft breath out through the nose.
Eyelids slightly lowered, gaze a little downward.
A very faint lift at the inner brows, a hint of tiredness and resignation.

② Tears welling:

The smirk is still on his mouth, but it has frozen.
Lower lids brimming with tears that swim in his eyes, catching the light, not falling.
Inner brows clearly raised, gaze turned up and away from the lens.
Jaw slightly tightened.

③ Blinking the tears back:

Catch the instant he blinks: both eyes squeezed shut, lashes wet and clumped together.
Brows slightly knitted, lips pressed together, jaw held tight.
The tears still don't reach his face.

④ Eyes open, tears held back:

He opens his eyes again, chin lifted a little, looking slightly up, using that angle to keep the tears from falling.
The whites of his eyes wet and glossy, rims damp, but his cheeks dry with no tear tracks.
Nostrils flared slightly, like he's drawing a deep breath.
Lips pressed into a line.

⑤ A resigned laugh:

Gaze drops back to the front, head lowered slightly.
Both mouth corners lift briefly, showing a little of the upper teeth, like a bitter laugh through the nose.
A few real smile lines at the corners of the eyes, but the inner brows are still raised, the sadness hasn't left.
Eyes moist, no tears falling, cheeks clean.

Skin tone lock: all five panels keep the natural skin tone of the reference image. No redness on the cheeks, nose tip or forehead; only the very edge of the eye rims may show a faint wet redness.

Style: realistic film still, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft side light, real skin texture and light reflecting in the tears, high detail. No cartoon look, no smoothed plastic skin.

Use the same woman, MIRA, from the reference image. Keep her face shape, facial proportions, platinum white hair, black leather jacket and mech neck guard exactly the same. Real skin pore texture, cinematic lighting. Change her eyes to cold grey irises, identical across all five frames, no brown.

Layout: ultra-wide 4:1 banner, split left to right into five equal close-ups (head to collarbone), each panel framed vertically. About 12px thin black dividers between panels. White circled numbers ①②③④⑤ in the top-left of each panel, thin white arrows → above the dividers to show the order. No other text. Same camera, light and background in all five panels; background is a cool dark grey.

Theme: crying while forcing a smile. She keeps trying to hold the smile, but the sadness seeps out through her brows and eyes step by step, until she can't hold it and presses her lips together to keep from crying.

① Calm and composed: face relaxed, lips naturally closed, brows level, steady gaze into the lens, no expression.

② A forced smile:

Zygomaticus major pulls the mouth corners up into a closed-mouth smile.
But the orbicularis oculi isn't engaged: lower lids don't lift, no crow's feet, so the smile never reaches the eyes.
Inner brows lift slightly, eye rims faintly red.

③ The first tear, still smiling:

Mouth corners still turned up, holding the smile.
Inner brows clearly raised and drawn together, faint horizontal lines across the middle of the forehead, an aggrieved slanted brow.
Lower lids brimming with tears, one tear running from the corner of one eye down to the cheekbone.
Nostrils slightly flared.

④ A trembling, toothy smile:

Lips parted to show the upper teeth, mouth corners pushed hard upward, but the upper lip is trembling and the two corners sit at different heights.
Chin muscles starting to tighten.
Brows knitted, inner ends raised high, both eyes brimming, two tear tracks on the cheeks.
Nose tip and skin around the eyes flushed.

⑤ Pressing her lips to hold it in (breaking):

Lips pressed hard inward into a thin line, lip color paling from the pressure.
Mouth corners pulled down, one corner still holding a little upward effort, like the last bit of the smile fighting.
Chin muscle pushing up hard, the chin surface puckered like orange peel.
Eyes squeezed half shut, orbicularis oculi contracted, squeezing out tears.
Brows furrowed into a vertical crease between them, inner ends raised.
Nostrils flared, a faint twitch.
Tears streaming down the cheeks to the jaw, cheeks and nose tip red, neck muscles slightly tense.
The whole face reads as fighting desperately to hold back a sob.

Style: realistic film still, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft side light, real skin texture and light catching the tears, high detail, no cartoon look, no smoothed plastic skin.

p:
Clash of Aura Dragons

【style】
Cinematic dark-fantasy epic, photoreal CGI with volumetric aura lighting. Deep teal-and-amber colour grade, heavy atmospheric fog, rim-lit characters against a stormy dusk sky. Camera feel: sweeping crane and push-in, handheld energy in combat beats. Tone arc: calm standoff → explosive clash → lingering dread. Core idea: two swordsmen channel dragon-shaped aura smoke — violet versus orange — in a duel where the pressure of unseen power matters more than the blades.

【cast】
SI BOZZX — @Image1 fixes his face: sharp jaw, short black hair, battle-scarred leather armour with a dark crimson sash; right hand grips a straight longsword whose blade trails wisps of VIOLET aura smoke. SI NOX — @Image2 fixes his face: gaunt, pale skin, long white hair tied back, black hooded coat with silver trim; left hand holds a curved sabre whose blade trails wisps of ORANGE aura smoke. The SPACE — @Image3 fixes the arena: a ruined stone plaza at dusk, cracked flagstones, broken pillars, low fog rolling across the ground, distant lightning behind silhouetted mountains. The aura dragons are NOT creatures — they are dense streams of coloured smoke shaped like coiling dragon forms, semi-transparent, trailing from the sword blades; violet for Bozzx, orange for Nox. They writhe and billow but have no solid body, no eyes, no roar — only a low serpentine flow of glowing fog. Bozzx's armour, Nox's coat, the plaza layout, and the crack pattern on the flagstones must stay identical in every shot.

【shots】
SHOT 1｜00:00–00:05｜Dusk. Wide crane shot over the ruined plaza. Fog curls across cracked flagstones. SI BOZZX stands far left, SI NOX stands far right, thirty paces apart. Both hold their swords at their sides; thin trails of violet and orange aura smoke drift from the blades. Distant thunder rolls. SI BOZZX says: "Nox. Akhirnya kita berhadapan." SHOT 2｜00:05–00:10｜Push-in on SI NOX (@Image2). Wind lifts his white hair. Orange aura smoke from his sabre thickens, coiling into a loose serpentine shape that loops once around his arm. Only Nox is in frame — no other person appears. He says: "Kau terlalu percaya diri, Bozzx." SHOT 3｜00:10–00:16｜Slow tracking shot moving left to right between them. Both raise swords. Violet smoke erupts from Bozzx's blade, orange smoke from Nox's — each stream swells into a coiling dragon-shaped aura cloud, four metres long, translucent, billowing with dread pressure. The two aura-dragons lunge at each other and collide mid-air in a churning vortex of violet and orange fog. Deep bass rumble and crackling hiss on the soundtrack. SHOT 4｜00:16–00:22｜Medium two-shot. The aura vortex expands between the fighters. Bozzx pushes forward through the fog; Nox braces. Sparks and embers fly from the clashing blades inside the smoke. Bozzx says: "Kekuatanmu tidak cukup!" Nox replies: "Kita lihat saja." SHOT 5｜00:22–00:27｜Low-angle close on SI BOZZX (@Image1). Violet aura-dragon smoke spirals around him, lighting his face in purple glow. His eyes narrow. He drives his sword forward. Only Bozzx is in frame — no other person appears. He shouts: "Hancur!" SHOT 6｜00:27–00:30｜Wide shot pulling back. The two aura-dragons implode into a massive burst of mixed violet-orange smoke that floods the entire plaza. Both figures are swallowed by the fog. Only the silhouette of broken pillars remains. Low rumble fades to wind.

【rules】
Events happen strictly in the order written. SI BOZZX speaks first, then SI NOX, then both exchange lines during the clash, then Bozzx's final shout — every line said exactly as written, no paraphrasing, no added words. Eyelines: Bozzx and Nox always look at each other across the plaza until fog obscures them. Props: each sword stays in the hand it was cast with; aura smoke always trails from the blade, never from the body. The aura-dragons are smoke only — never solidify, never grow eyes or teeth, never roar; they coil, billow, and collide as coloured fog. Scale: each aura-dragon form reaches roughly four metres before impact, no larger. Lighting stays dusk throughout — never shifts to noon or full night. Avoid face changes between shots, extra limbs, duplicated swords, warped or random on-screen text, wrong spellings of names, and constant camera shake; camera moves are deliberate crane, push-in, track, or pull-back only.
