Cut to a tight three-quarter facial close-up.
She holds the pipette just above her right upper cheek, safely below and away from the eye. A gentle bulb squeeze releases exactly one rounded drop of milky serum onto the cheek.

8.2–10.2s | SMOOTH IT IN

10.2–13.8s | APPLY THE LIPSTICK
Cut to a clear close-up of her lower face and right hand.
An uncapped berry-rose lipstick is already raised near her mouth. Its cap rests on the vanity.
Looking toward a mirror just beside the camera, she parts her lips slightly and applies the lipstick with two controlled passes: one across the lower lip, then one following the upper lip.
Color appears progressively along the actual contact path. The lipstick bullet stays solid and follows the lip contours accurately.
She lightly presses her lips together once to settle the color.

【镜头12｜27—30秒｜神秘面部特写】

摄影与连续性约束：
打斗切镜发生在抢攻、闪避、转身、接触与位移中，下一镜承接动作后半程，不重复起手。全景交代包夹、脚下与落点，中景呈现连续攻防，短近景强调实际接触；不切到无关表情让战斗暂停。手持变化来自摄影师跟进、退让和重新找角度，不使用持续随机震屏。三名男子不能排队等待，也不能同时堆叠在同一个接触点；被同伴挡住者绕行寻找攻击通路。女学生的冷静表情不等于身体慢速。无长时间蓄势、站定对视、悬空挥拳、轮流单击、倒地复活、肢体穿模、血液或伤口特写。

提示词在这：
一只高度写实的博美幼犬躲在温馨卧室里柔软的灰色毛毯下面，身下是一张舒适的床，房间充满温暖、柔和的光线。博美幼犬的毛发以纯白色为主，耳朵、额头、脸颊和背部有少量自然的暖金黄色毛发。只有它圆润、蓬松的小脸和一双大大的深棕色眼睛从毛毯下面露出来。
小狗安静地注视着站在手机后面的人。它缓慢眨眼，脑袋轻轻向左、向右歪动。小巧的三角形耳朵微微抖动，胡须自然摆动，小小的黑色鼻子好奇地嗅闻着。
短暂停顿后，小狗慢慢从毛毯下面完全爬出来。它压低身体，摆出准备玩耍扑击的姿势。屁股左右扭动两次，蓬松卷曲的尾巴兴奋地轻轻抽动，瞳孔稍微放大。
毫无预警地，它突然以爆发性的速度直接扑向摄像机。
第一人称视角，摄像机就是观众的手机屏幕。小狗笔直地飞向镜头。即将撞上的一瞬间，它将两只前爪向前伸出，仿佛想要抓住屏幕前的观众。
紧接着——
砰！
小狗一头撞在摄像机前方那块看不见的玻璃上。撞击沉重、有力，并且符合真实物理效果。
它整张蓬松的小脸紧紧贴在玻璃上。小小的黑色鼻子被完全压扁，蓬松的脸颊向两侧挤开，嘴唇被压成滑稽的形状。胡须被玻璃压弯并朝两侧展开，小巧的耳朵因撞击向后压平。
其中一只眼睛被挤得稍微大一些，另一只眼睛则受到轻微压缩。碰撞使它粉红色的小舌头突然从嘴角弹出来，并且意外粘在玻璃上。
两只前爪同时“啪”地拍在玻璃表面，柔软的粉色与黑色小肉垫清晰可见。小狗的表情瞬间从充满自信的顽皮，变成彻底的困惑和茫然。
撞击发生的准确瞬间，写实的智能手机钢化玻璃上出现戏剧性的放射状蜘蛛网裂纹。裂纹以小狗被压扁的鼻子为中心，迅速蔓延至几乎整个屏幕。
玻璃依然保持完整，没有出现破洞，也没有任何玻璃碎片掉落。少量细微的玻璃粉尘短暂漂浮在空中，在温暖的光线下微微闪烁。
小狗保持着整张脸被压在玻璃上的状态大约一秒。它的舌头依然粘在玻璃上，鼻子留下一小块朦胧的雾气鼻印，舌头也留下一点湿润的痕迹。
它的一只眼睛慢慢变成斗鸡眼，并在完全困惑的状态下眨眼两次。嘴巴微微张开，露出十分滑稽的表情。即使脸仍然紧贴着玻璃，两侧蓬松的脸颊还在轻微抖动。
随后，重力开始慢慢将小狗向下拉。
它的脸依然紧贴着布满裂纹的玻璃，并沿着玻璃表面缓慢向下滑动。脸颊在玻璃上拖动，被压扁的鼻子稍微向下拉长。粘在玻璃上的舌头被滑稽地拉长，最后以轻微而富有弹性的动作从玻璃上剥离。
两只前爪也慢慢沿着玻璃向下滑，在玻璃表面留下几个细小的爪印。
小狗逐渐从画面底部消失。
紧接着，短短一瞬之后——
咚！
小狗安全地仰面摔落在摄像机下方。四只爪子全部朝上，蓬松的肚皮完全露出来，粉红色的小舌头依然伸在嘴巴外面。
它的双眼慢慢变成夸张、滑稽的卡通螺旋眼。一只小耳朵轻轻抽动一次，一条后腿不由自主地蹬了一下。蓬松卷曲的尾巴无力地轻轻甩动一次。胸口随着自然呼吸缓慢而轻柔地起伏。
安静躺了一会儿后，其中一只眼睛短暂恢复正常，仿佛它正在努力清醒过来。小狗随后慢慢摇了摇脑袋。
画面无缝渐变回故事开头。小狗再次安静地从毛毯下面探出蓬松的小脸，与第一个镜头完美衔接，形成自然流畅的无限循环。
超写实博美幼犬，毛发以纯白色为主，带有少量自然的暖金黄色毛发区域，整段视频中的毛色分布和外观始终保持一致，极其细腻的蓬松长毛，柔软浓密的双层被毛，自然真实的犬类行为，符合真实物理规律的身体动作，真实可信的面部撞击与玻璃挤压变形，写实的智能手机钢化玻璃裂纹，电影级灯光，温暖的室内氛围，4K HDR，竖屏9:16，浅景深，可爱、滑稽、温馨治愈，适合作为手机动态壁纸，首尾完美无缝循环。

Reference image: use the uploaded image as the character's identity and costume (pale porcelain skin, long platinum-blonde waved hair, jeweled silver tiara, drop earrings and choker, pale blue satin ball gown with silver bead embroidery and multicolored jewels, lace cuffs, pale blue beaded satin heel). Keep her identical in every cut. Refer to her only as the PRINCESS.

15-second cinematic fairy-tale sequence, 20 hard cuts (about 0.75 seconds each), 4:5 vertical, photorealistic, 24fps. A rose garden on a bright sunny day, deep blue cloudless sky, with a giant ornate golden carriage wheel beside her. The PRINCESS stands by the carriage with a cold, regal stare. She lifts her skirt, steps out onto the grass in her glass-like slipper, and walks toward the camera with quiet, imperious confidence. Strong midday sunlight, saturated colors, crisp shadows, light breeze moving her hair and skirt. Consistent location, lighting and wardrobe across all cuts. Fast, rhythmic editing with one smooth continuous action across the cuts.

Cuts:
1. (0.00-0.75s) Extreme low-angle wide shot, ultra-wide lens: the PRINCESS towers over the camera beside the golden carriage wheel, blue sky behind her.
2. (0.75-1.50s) Wide shot, eye level: the PRINCESS stands still among the rose bushes, breeze lifting her hair.
3. (1.50-2.25s) Medium shot, front: her chin lifts slightly, a cold, unimpressed expression.
4. (2.25-3.00s) Extreme close-up, front: her eyes, pale lashes, and the sparkle of her tiara above.
5. (3.00-3.75s) Close-up, side profile: the jeweled drop earring and choker catch the sun.
6. (3.75-4.50s) Extreme close-up, macro: her fingers gather the satin skirt, jewels and beadwork glittering.
7. (4.50-5.25s) Low angle, looking up: she raises the hem, the huge embroidered skirt filling the frame.
8. (5.25-6.00s) Ground-level shot in the grass: her beaded pale blue slipper lifts and steps forward, grass blades bending.
9. (6.00-6.75s) Detail shot, slightly low: the slipper presses into the grass, sunlight sparkling on the pearls.
10. (6.75-7.50s) Side tracking shot, medium: the PRINCESS walks away from the carriage, the golden wheel sliding past behind her.
11. (7.50-8.25s) Dutch angle, medium wide: she walks, the rose hedges and sky tilted behind her.
12. (8.25-9.00s) Rear tracking shot: her long waved hair and the embroidered back of the gown, following her through the garden.
13. (9.00-9.75s) High angle, top-down: the skirt sweeping across the green lawn, jeweled hem glittering.
14. (9.75-10.50s) Front tracking shot, backing away: she walks toward the camera with an imperious stare.
15. (10.50-11.25s) Close-up, three-quarter angle: her face in hard sunlight, the tiara glinting, expression unmoved.
16. (11.25-12.00s) Low angle, wide: the PRINCESS silhouetted against the deep blue sky, skirt billowing in the breeze.
17. (12.00-12.75s) Medium shot, side: she stops and slowly turns her head toward the camera.
18. (12.75-13.50s) Slow push-in, close-up front: a faint, cold, knowing smile.
19. (13.50-14.25s) Orbit shot, medium: the camera arcs around her, the golden wheel and roses sweeping past behind.
20. (14.25-15.00s) Final extreme low-angle wide shot, slow pull-back: the PRINCESS standing tall in the grass beside the golden carriage wheel, blue sky above, holding the pose.

Style: 35mm film photography look, saturated Kodak-style color, deep blue sky, crisp natural sunlight, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, realistic skin texture, realistic satin, lace, bead and jewel detail, realistic hair and cloth physics. 【全局基准｜GLOBAL】制作一段25秒高能街球动作动画，厚涂美漫×NPR赛璐璐三渲二×Hip-Hop街头广告视觉。以黑、荧光橙、青蓝、米白为主色，粗犷手绘笔触、硬边大色块、哑光材质、网点阴影与少量漫画速度线，减少细碎描边和反光点。球场主光方向固定，远处霓虹只提供环境色。24fps摄影，人物姿态适量采用12fps错帧质感，运球、传球与身体接触保持连续。篮球始终是普通篮球，所有超现实动作来自局部重力变化、墙面反弹和空中身体控制。

【8—14秒｜篮球跟随特写转纵向全景／随球低位仰拍／摄影旋转90°／Ball Cam＋纵向拉升＋甩镜】JAYE把球砸向左侧重力板，板面触发局部重力变化，篮球沿墙面向上弹升。她连续蹬墙追球，两台安保机紧跟。摄影旋转，让墙面短暂成为视觉上的地面。N-23按训练程序提前站稳做掩护，将追击路线分成两侧，再顺势向右侧篮筐前的两分区跟进。人物与球的位置连续可追踪。

【18—22秒｜空中全景转背部近景／与人物同高／轻微倾斜后回正／快速推近＋Whip Pan】三台安保机启动推进器，形成三角包夹。JAYE摆出即将完成高难度终结的姿态，在它们同时扑来的瞬间嘴角一扬，突然背后传球。篮球沿清楚的抛物线穿过包夹空隙，传给地面的N-23；甩镜沿球路跟到接球队友，三台安保机齐刷刷转头。

REFERENCE AND IDENTITY LOCK
Each character sheet shows multiple views of ONE person. Render one complete woman and one complete man, both with intact heads. Preserve their reference faces, proportions, skin tones, hair, wardrobe, accessories and painterly material treatment precisely. The woman's brass instrument remains on her anatomical LEFT forearm. Match the man's shoulder armor to his actual reference image. The reference images take priority over inferred costume details.

Preserve the references’ sculpted, hand-painted animation aesthetic: angular facial planes, visible brush textures, selective sharp edges, rich violet shadows, turquoise ambient light and warm copper highlights. Dimensional animated filmmaking, not live-action or glossy plastic rendering.

SCENE AND GEOGRAPHY
Inside the referenced abandoned pumping station, the enormous pump wheel stands beneath the rear arched window. Canal railing stays left, furnace and staircase stay right. Keep the existing architecture recognizable.

The woman stands screen-left at a waist-high brass control socket attached to the pump housing. The man stands screen-right, one step behind her, holding down a stiff mechanical safety lever with his RIGHT hand. Both faces are visible in the first frame. Her left forearm instrument is already aligned with the socket; her right hand supports its casing.

They are trying to restart the station together. She needs his trust; he needs her to finish without getting hurt.

FOUR SHOTS — EXACTLY 10 SECONDS
Hard cuts at 2.2, 4.3 and 7.0 seconds. One clear camera movement per shot. Maintain the woman-left / man-right screen relationship and stay on the same side of their interaction axis.

SHOT 1 — 0.0–2.2s
Low, wide two-shot, seen just above a shallow foreground puddle. Both characters and the dormant wheel are readable immediately. A short lateral camera slide clears a foreground pipe, revealing their full working relationship.

The woman presses her left forearm instrument into the socket. Before committing, she checks the man's face to see whether he will keep holding the lever. He meets her look and deliberately braces his weight against it. She turns her attention back to the connection. A thin cyan seam lights inside the socket.

HARD CUT.

SHOT 2 — 2.2–4.3s
Intimate medium close-up from beside the pump housing: her face dominates the left foreground, his face remains readable behind her on the right. A restrained forward push closes the distance.

Cyan light climbs from the connected instrument onto her cheek. She watches the mechanism for a response, then checks him again, seeking acknowledgment that it worked. His attention moves past her toward a vibrating pressure coupling beside the wheel. His grip tightens on the safety lever. The mechanical hum becomes uneven; a bolt rattles visibly in its seat.

HARD CUT ON THE METALLIC SNAP.

SHOT 3 — 4.3–7.0s
Low, wide side view with both full bodies visible from the first frame. A fast, short backward tracking move makes room for their retreat.

The coupling vents a single forceful jet of white steam above shoulder height, aimed toward the empty foreground, not into either face. The woman recoils one step, disengaging her forearm instrument from the socket. The man releases the lever and catches her RIGHT upper arm with his LEFT hand, guiding her behind his shoulder as he takes one grounded step back.

Their boots displace shallow water. Her jacket hem and his long coat respond to the pressure with delayed fabric movement. The heavy pump wheel begins turning behind them. The danger is brief and physically localized, not an explosion that destroys the room.

HARD CUT.

SHOT 4 — 7.0–10.0s
Medium-wide two-shot from the same side of the action axis. The woman remains left and the man right; the rear arch and distant city are visible between and above them. A smooth backward dolly widens the composition.

He releases her arm once she has her footing. She briefly meets his eyes, checking whether he still trusts her. Before either can settle, a deep mechanical pulse sounds beyond the station. He notices the distant response first; she follows his gaze a fraction later.

Beyond the arch, three successive clusters of amber windows switch on across the previously dark city, traveling away into the distance. Their successful repair has awakened a larger connected system. Both turn toward it, their partnership now facing a new question.

End with the wheel still turning, water trembling and their attention fixed on the awakening city. No freeze-frame or fade to black.

ACTING TASK
Shared direction: complete the restart together without abandoning each other.

Woman: win his continued cooperation by making the machine respond. Her obstacle is that the machinery becomes dangerous just as she proves her point. Pursue his trust through purposeful checks of his face; after the rescue, assess his response instead of celebrating or posing.

Man: give her the chance to succeed while keeping her within reach. His obstacle is that protecting her may require interrupting the experiment. First support her by holding the lever; then redirect her physically out of danger. Afterward, check her footing before investigating the distant sound.

Keep attention engaged with the partner or the active mechanism. Natural blinks, responsive breathing, no fixed smiles, synchronized reactions or blank heroic stares.

LIGHT, PHYSICS AND SOUND
Maintain turquoise window light from rear-left and warm furnace light from the right. The cyan activation adds localized illumination to nearby skin and brass; it does not replace the established lighting. Preserve face readability through the steam.

Bodies retain weight and traction. The man guides rather than throws her. Machinery accelerates with inertia. Steam disperses and wet footprints persist across cuts. Painted highlights and moving shadows follow the same stable character forms.

Audio: water drips, strained lever creak, electrical resonance, one sharp metal snap, a short steam blast, wet footfalls, accelerating gears, then a distant low mechanical response from the city. Brief natural exertion breaths. No dialogue or vocals.

Exactly two characters throughout. No additional figures, costume changes, identity swaps, duplicated bodies, floating accessories, text, subtitles, logos or reference-sheet layouts.

= the skater (character sheet)

Use the character sheet as the strict reference for the skater's identity, facial features, hairstyle, body type, outfit, and personality. Keep the face, proportions, outfit silhouette, hairstyle, and natural imperfections exactly as shown.

IMPORTANT:
Do not redesign the outfit.
Do not over-stylize the skater.

Create a 15-second, 16:9 widescreen, ultra-cinematic street skateboarding video set in Shibuya, Tokyo, in late October, at blue-hour dawn around 5:30 AM.

ONE CONTINUOUS TAKE. No cuts, no edits, no transitions — a single unbroken handheld shot from start to finish.

The skater rides only on the sidewalk the entire time, never on the roadway.

The city is almost empty and silent.
Shop shutters are still down. An occasional Tokyo taxi glides past on the road beside the sidewalk.
The sidewalk tiles are still wet from overnight rain, and the first morning light slowly spreads across them.
Crisp, cool autumn air. A few fallen yellow ginkgo leaves scattered on the wet sidewalk.

IMPORTANT:
The environment must feel unmistakably like real Shibuya.

Include:
Wide Shibuya sidewalks with wet paving tiles and yellow tactile paving strips
Metal guardrails and bollards along the curb
Dark navy Tokyo taxis (JPN Taxi) passing on the road alongside
The empty Shibuya Scramble Crossing visible in the distance
Pedestrian signals and traffic lights
Closed metal shutters along the storefronts
Dense mixed-use buildings with exterior emergency stairs
Giant switched-off billboard screens
A Tokyo Metro station entrance on the sidewalk
Stickers and graffiti on utility poles and shutters
Overhead power lines
Cool, slightly damp late-autumn dawn atmosphere

Core feeling:
Extreme speed
Urban freedom
Youthful energy
Raw realism
Dangerous momentum
A playful face reveal at the very end

Camera work:
Extremely immersive handheld chase shot from BEHIND the skater, low-angle throughout.
From 0 to 12 seconds, the camera operator sprints along the sidewalk at full speed, chasing the skater from behind at close range, with the lens kept low — just above the sidewalk tiles to knee height — looking forward past the skater's legs and board toward the empty sidewalk ahead. We see the skater's back, hair whipping in the wind, and the board, with the buildings and the brightening sky ahead.

IMPORTANT:
Until the final moment, the camera stays behind the skater — directly behind, or rear three-quarter at most. It never overtakes the skater, never runs ahead, and never shoots from the front or the side. The skater's face is not shown until the final moment.

Techniques, all within the single continuous take:
Ultra-low-angle rear tracking, the lens skimming just above the wet tiles
Following close behind the board, with the wheels and tail filling the foreground
Shifting between directly-behind and rear three-quarter angles
Dynamic reframing as the skater swerves left and right
Motion blur
Impact shake on every landing
Imperfect, reactive framing
Camera chasing dangerously close behind the skater down the stairs alongside the handrail, brushing past guardrails and walls

The viewer should physically feel speed, danger, and momentum.

Avoid perfectly centered framing. Use the width of the 16:9 frame: keep the skater on the left or right third, with the sidewalk ahead opening up on the other side, and let the tactile paving strips, the tile joints, the curb line, the guardrails, and the rail converge toward the vanishing point as strong diagonal leading lines.

Allowed:
Momentary cropping
Framing drift
Chaotic handheld movement
Aggressive camera corrections

Action — a continuous line of tricks down the empty Shibuya sidewalk, one flowing into the next without stopping, all seen from behind until the final moment:

0–2s: The skater pushes hard down the sidewalk, building dangerous speed past the closed shutters, hair streaming back toward the lens.
2–4s: Kickflip over a fallen ginkgo-leaf patch, the board flipping right in front of the low camera, clean catch, lands rolling.
4–6s: Long nose manual balanced along the yellow tactile paving strip, then pops out.
6–9s: Approaches a long metal handrail beside a set of concrete stairs, pops into the air, and lands a perfect boardslide down the full length of the rail, the camera chasing down the stairs right behind.
9–10s: Pops out of the rail with a 360 shove-it — the board spins a full turn beneath the skater's feet while the body keeps facing forward — and lands hard on the sidewalk below.
10–12s: Rolls straight into a quick 360 flip, lands it, and carves into a sharp powerslide across the wet tiles, spraying a thin mist of water, coming to a stop.
12–15s: The face reveal. The skater stomps on the tail so the board pops up into their hand, then turns around to face back toward the camera. The camera catches up and stops at close range, still slightly low. The skater looks straight into the lens, breaks into a big, genuine smile, and flashes a cute peace sign with a slight playful head tilt. The face is sharp and fully visible for the first time, framed on the right third, with the long Shibuya sidewalk and the glowing dawn sky behind.

Every trick must be landed cleanly with real weight and board contact.
The peace-sign moment must feel natural and spontaneous, like a real person goofing for a friend's camera — not a posed model shot.

Trick feeling:
Real, dangerous, world-class, varied.

Physics:
No floaty physics.
No superhero movement.
No anime-style exaggeration.
Realistic hang time, realistic board flip speed, wheels and trucks clearly hitting the ground on each landing.

Lighting:
Cinematic late-October blue-hour dawn in Shibuya.
Combine:
Cool early-morning ambient light
Soft sunrise glow on the upper floors of the buildings, and soft dawn light falling on the skater's face in the final moment
Reflections of leftover neon and signal lights on the wet sidewalk tiles
Cool, damp autumn air
Realistic dawn exposure

Texture:
Realistic skin pores
Realistic wet paving-tile texture
Slight sweat
Sensor noise
Cinematic grain
Natural clothing movement

Sound:
Hip-hop music: a hard-hitting boom-bap / trap-influenced instrumental with heavy kicks, crisp snares, and a deep bassline, cinematic and gritty.
Tricks hit on the beat — each landing syncs with a kick or snare.
A massive beat drop exactly at the moment the skater lands on the handrail boardslide.
The beat hits one final accent exactly as the peace sign goes up.
Layered with real diegetic sound: wheels rolling on wet tiles, the pop of the tail, trucks grinding on the metal rail, hard landings, the skater's heavy breathing and a short laugh at the end.

Overall vibe:
A legendary viral Shibuya skate clip, secretly shot at dawn.

0–5s — TAKEOFF:
On a grassy cliff above floating islands, the panda checks both wings, starts the propeller, and pilots its aircraft down a sloping ramp. The machine launches into the sky. The panda smiles as the islands spread out below.

Two fighters, one rooftop, and constant momentum. The idea is to connect each strike, recoil, and counter while the camera follows the action through exaggerated perspective and impact flashes.

Condensed prompt:

Create a 30-second, four-shot 2D anime fight between two adult women. Bold outlines, flat colors, hard cel shading, deep foreshortening, speed smears, and brief two-frame impact drawings. Blue-teal backgrounds flash pink or orange on contact.

Character references

Mina: long black hair, green striped crop top, orange graffiti cargo pants, white sneakers, black fingerless boxing gloves, chain bracelet.

Rue: long pink hair, black crop top, black cargo shorts with chains, bare hands with silver rings, lime sneakers, dog tags.

Keep their identities, outfits, and hand accessories distinct throughout.

Location: empty concrete rooftop, rear chain-link fence, steel vent at center-right. Mina begins left, Rue right. Maintain readable spacing, depth, and movement.

VISUAL STYLE:
High-quality whimsical 3D animated-film aesthetic. A cute little green frog wearing a yellow raincoat and a tiny brown satchel navigates a miniature garden during heavy rain. Detailed wet leaves, muddy soil, puddles, tiny insects, soft overcast lighting, and expressive character animation. Charming storybook visuals with cinematic camera movement.

CHARACTER AND PROP CONSISTENCY:
One small green frog with large expressive eyes, a yellow raincoat, and a brown satchel. The frog builds a boat from one broad green leaf and a small twig mast. Three tiny beetles with distinct red, blue, and orange shells are the passengers. Preserve their appearances and the boat design throughout.

0–5s — THE FLOOD:
Heavy rain pours into a backyard garden. Water rushes between flowerpots, turning a narrow soil path into a fast-moving stream. Three tiny beetles cling to a raised stone as the water rises around them. The frog spots them from a nearby overturned flowerpot and immediately rushes to help.

5–10s — BUILDING THE BOAT:
The frog grabs a broad fallen leaf and places a short twig across it for support. It carefully lowers the leaf into a shallow puddle, climbs aboard, and paddles with two smaller leaf fragments. The current carries the frog toward the stranded beetles.

10–16s — THE RESCUE:
The frog reaches the stone and helps the three beetles climb onto the leaf boat. As the last beetle boards, a surge of rainwater pushes the boat away. The frog paddles hard, steering between floating petals and small stones. All three beetles remain safely aboard.

16–22s — THE WATERFALL:
The stream suddenly narrows and flows over the edge of a small garden ledge. The frog spots the drop and paddles toward a low branch extending over the water. The boat passes beneath it. The frog grabs the branch, slowing the boat just before the ledge, then uses the branch to swing the boat into a calm puddle below.

22–27s — SAFE AT LAST:
The leaf boat glides into a sheltered space beneath a large mushroom. The rain becomes gentler. The beetles climb onto dry ground, shake off the water, and happily thank the frog with excited gestures. The frog smiles and wrings out its soaked raincoat.

27–30s — THE PAYOFF:
The clouds part. A warm beam of sunlight illuminates the flooded garden. The frog and beetles look up as a tiny rainbow appears over the flowerpots. The leaf boat floats gently beside them as the camera pulls back to reveal their miniature world.

AUDIO:
Continuous rain pattering on leaves, water trickling and rushing, tiny splashes, leaf rustling, and soft wooden-twig creaks. Increase the water's intensity during the rescue and waterfall sequence. Add a brief tense musical swell as the boat approaches the ledge, followed by warm, playful orchestral music when everyone reaches safety.

The branch slows and redirects the boat before the ledge; no impossible jump or sudden teleportation. Use connected shots, coherent geography, readable actions, and believable movement. Create a 30-second cinematic 3D animated short film about a tiny red toy race car turning an ordinary bedroom desk into an exciting racetrack.

**VISUAL STYLE:** Premium stylized 3D animation, charming miniature-scale details, realistic toy materials, warm afternoon sunlight, expressive movement, cinematic tracking shots, and convincing physics. The car must remain the same bright red toy race car with black wheels, a white racing stripe, and a small rear spoiler throughout. No text, logos, or watermarks.

**SCENE 1 — THE START (0–5s)**
A red toy race car sits at the top of a wooden pencil resting diagonally against a thick book. The camera drops to the car's tiny eye-level perspective. Its wheels spin, then it shoots down the pencil, launches off an eraser, and lands on the desk. Begin the race immediately with energetic movement.

**SCENE 2 — THE DESK CIRCUIT (5–12s)**
The car races between scattered pencils, narrowly avoids a rolling coin, and climbs a ruler bridging two stacks of books. The camera follows close behind as it speeds across the ruler, drops through a tunnel formed by an open book, and emerges onto a smooth notebook cover. Every obstacle connects naturally to the next.

**SCENE 3 — THE BIG JUMP (12–19s)**
Ahead, a fallen pencil creates a ramp leading toward the far edge of the desk. The car accelerates across the notebook, climbs the ramp, and launches into the air. Use a brief slow-motion side view as it sails past a desk lamp, then lands on a folded paper plane lying below. The paper plane bends under the impact but stays intact.

The paper plane slides off the desk and glides into the open room. The toy car rides on top, wobbling as the plane banks around a chair. It descends toward an open backpack on the floor, which is directly beneath its flight path.

**SCENE 5 — PERFECT PARKING (25–30s)**
The paper plane lands inside the open backpack, sliding to a stop among books and pencil cases. The red car rolls off the plane and parks perfectly in a small side pocket. A human hand reaches down, picks up the backpack, and lifts it away. End with a close-up of the car sitting proudly in its new spot.

**CAMERA AND AUDIO:** Use low-angle tracking shots, quick pans, close-up wheel shots, and brief slow motion during the jump. Build a playful soundtrack from wheel clicks, pencil rattles, ruler vibrations, paper flutters, and soft landing sounds. Music rises during the jump and resolves with a satisfying final note.

1960s french romantic comedy film, a rainy afternoon in paris, sequence of cuts.

wardrobe, fixed for the whole film: the woman wears only a sleeveless white
dress, no coat, no jacket, no trench. the man wears a white shirt and a brown
tweed jacket on top, nothing else over it, no coat, no raincoat.

0-4s: wide static shot of a narrow parisian street in light rain, wet
cobblestones, haussmann facades, a cafe with a striped awning. a young woman in
her mid-twenties with a short black bob and bangs, in her white dress, holding
a bouquet of pink peonies, waits at the edge of the curb next to a big puddle.

4-7s: cut to low side tracking shot along the curb, a mint green italian scooter
ridden by the man in the brown tweed jacket speeds through the puddle, a huge
sheet of water splashes over the woman from head to toe.

7-10s: cut to medium static shot of the woman, soaked, hair dripping, her white
dress wet, mouth open in shock, the peonies drooping. behind her the scooter
brakes and stops.

10-14s: cut to medium static shot, the man, early thirties, tousled dark hair,
walks the scooter back to her, apologizing with both hands raised: "pardon,
mademoiselle!" he takes off the brown tweed jacket, underneath he wears only
the white shirt.

14-18s: cut to close-up two-shot, static, he drapes the brown tweed jacket over
her bare shoulders, now he stands in his white shirt in the rain, she glares
at him.

18-21s: cut to close-up of the woman, static, wearing the brown tweed jacket
over her white dress, she tries to stay angry, her lips tremble, then she
bursts out laughing.

21-26s: cut to side tracking shot alongside the scooter, she rides sidesaddle
behind him, wearing the brown tweed jacket, holding the peonies and his waist,
he rides in his wet white shirt, rain on their faces, both laughing, paris
facades sliding past.

26-30s: cut to wide static shot of a cafe terrace, the scooter hits another big
puddle and splashes a stern elderly gentleman with a mustache, bowler hat and
newspaper at a table. she laughs and hides her face in the man's back as the
scooter disappears into the rain.

audio: 1960s french film score: playful jazz piano trio, brushed drums,
vibraphone, lush strings and a light wordless female "ba-da-ba" vocal, the
tempo matching the scooter. foley: steady rain, two-stroke scooter putter, a
big water splash, her gasp, his apology, her laughter, a second splash and the
gentleman's indignant grunt.

style: shot on 35mm eastmancolor film, 1.66:1 frame, soft pastel colors, grey
blue paris with accents of white dress, mint scooter and pink peonies, fine
grain, slight fade, kinoptik and angenieux lenses at f/2, backlit rain, bokeh
from shop windows and streetlamps reflected on wet cobblestones, overcast soft
light, warm cafe windows.

constraints: real-time speed, no slow motion, no readable text, no logos, no
brand names, no helmets, no modern cars or objects, only one jacket exists in
the film: the brown tweed jacket, no extra coats or layers on anyone, preserve
both faces across all cuts, no morphing hands.
